### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T13:33:22.469Z)

Done — hover-to-reveal route vertices with drag-to-add-waypoint is implemented, browser-verified, and committed locally as `57bf6c5`.

**How it works**
- `src/components/map/RouteLayer.tsx` — added an invisible 20px-wide `route-hit` line over the route so hovering is forgiving.
- `src/utils/routeVertices.ts` — builds one point per interior route vertex, each tagged with a `minzoom` so handles stay ≥28px apart at any zoom (kept handles persist as you zoom in, new ones fill in between); also `waypointInsertIndex()` which places the new stop after every existing waypoint the route reaches before the dragged vertex.
- `src/components/map/RouteVertices.tsx` — circle layer of handles shown only while the cursor is over the route (250ms grace so moving line→handle doesn't flicker), hovered handle fills blue with a grab cursor. Mousedown on a handle calls `preventDefault()` so the map doesn't pan, a grey ghost marker follows the cursor, and mouseup dispatches `addWaypoint({coordinates, index})`. The existing recalculation keyed on waypoint coordinates then re-routes.
- `src/components/map/MapContainer.tsx` — mounts `RouteVertices` and ignores the `click` maplibre fires after the drop (via `suppressClickRef`) so it doesn't also add a stray waypoint. Hint text updated.

**Verified in Chrome (your dev server, on port 3000 today)**: handles appear along the whole route on hover; dragging a Harlem River vertex to Hunts Point created waypoint 1 and re-routed; dragging a Secaucus-side vertex afterwards correctly became #1 with Hunts Point shifting to #2. One bug found and fixed during testing (the drop handler was removing the permanent hover listener, killing hover after the first drag). `tsc` is clean; the console shows only the known dev-only hydration warnings.

Not done: I haven't built/deployed to Cloud Run or pushed to GitHub — say the word and I'll run the usual image build → `terraform apply` → push. The test tab is still open at localhost:3000 if you want to try it.

```bash
/**
 * Basemap style catalog (NextBillion-hosted TomTom v2 styles) and URL
 * builders shared by the map, the Layers control and the sprite loader.
 */

export type MapStyleId =
  | 'basic_street-light'
  | 'basic_mono-light'
  | 'basic_street-satellite'
  | 'basic_mono-dark'
  | 'basic_street-dark';

export interface MapStyleOption {
  id: MapStyleId;
  label: string;
  /** Whether the style is dark-themed (picks dark traffic overlays). */
  dark: boolean;
  /** Placeholder colour shown behind the thumbnail while it loads. */
  swatch: string;
}

export const MAP_STYLE_OPTIONS: MapStyleOption[] = [
  { id: 'basic_street-light', label: 'Street', dark: false, swatch: '#f3efe6' },
  { id: 'basic_mono-light', label: 'Mono', dark: false, swatch: '#e9e9e9' },
  { id: 'basic_street-satellite', label: 'Satellite', dark: true, swatch: '#3b4a3a' },
  { id: 'basic_mono-dark', label: 'Mono dark', dark: true, swatch: '#2b2b2b' },
  { id: 'basic_street-dark', label: 'Dark', dark: true, swatch: '#1f2733' },
];

export const DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE: MapStyleId = 'basic_street-light';

const STYLE_BASE = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/tt/style/1/style/25.2.3-0';
const SPRITE_BASE = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/tt/style/1/sprite/25.2.3-0/sprite@2x';

export function getMapStyleOption(id: MapStyleId): MapStyleOption {
  return MAP_STYLE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.id === id) ?? MAP_STYLE_OPTIONS[0];
}

/** Full style URL for a basemap, optionally with traffic overlays. */
export function buildMapStyleUrl(
  id: MapStyleId,
  options: { traffic?: boolean; apiKey?: string } = {}
): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ map: `2/${id}` });
  if (options.traffic) {
    const theme = getMapStyleOption(id).dark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    params.set('traffic_incidents', `2/incidents_${theme}`);
    params.set('traffic_flow', `2/flow_relative-${theme}`);
  }
  if (options.apiKey) params.set('key', options.apiKey);
  return `${STYLE_BASE}?${params.toString()}`;
}

/** Sprite sheet (JSON + PNG) URLs for a basemap style. */
export function buildSpriteUrls(id: MapStyleId, apiKey: string) {
  const qs = `?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey)}&map=${encodeURIComponent(`2/${id}`)}`;
  return { json: `${SPRITE_BASE}.json${qs}`, png: `${SPRITE_BASE}.png${qs}` };
}
EOF

/** Loads (and caches) the sprite sheet of a basemap style. */
export function loadSpriteSheet(
  style: MapStyleId = DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE
): Promise<SpriteSheet> {
  let pending = cache.get(style);
  if (!pending) {
    const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEXTBILLION_API_KEY ?? '';
    const urls = buildSpriteUrls(style, key);
    pending = fetch(urls.json)
      .then((r) => {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`sprite fetch failed (${r.status})`);
        return r.json();
      })
      .then((meta: Record<string, SpriteIconMeta>) => {
        let sheetW = 0;
        let sheetH = 0;
        for (const m of Object.values(meta)) {
          sheetW = Math.max(sheetW, m.x + m.width);
          sheetH = Math.max(sheetH, m.y + m.height);
        }
        return { url: urls.png, meta, sheetW, sheetH };
      });
    cache.set(style, pending);
    // Allow a retry on failure instead of caching the rejection
    pending.catch(() => {
      if (cache.get(style) === pending) cache.delete(style);
    });
  }
  return pending;
}

import { Shield } from '../sidebar/Shield';
import {
  loadSpriteSheet,
  pickShieldGlyph,
  SpriteSheet,
} from '@/utils/spriteShields';

let sheetState: SpriteSheet | null = null;

function useSpriteSheet(): SpriteSheet | null {
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<SpriteSheet | null>(sheetState);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sheet) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    loadSpriteSheet()
      .then((s) => {
        sheetState = s;
        if (!cancelled) setSheet(s);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // keep SVG fallback
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [sheet]);
  return sheet;
}

import {

  SpriteSheet,
} from '@/utils/spriteShields';
import type { MapStyleId } from '@/utils/mapStyles';

// Resolved sheets by style, so re-mounts render synchronously
const sheets = new Map<MapStyleId, SpriteSheet>();

/** Sprite sheet of the basemap style currently shown on the map. */
function useSpriteSheet(): SpriteSheet | null {
  const style = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapStyle);
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<SpriteSheet | null>(
    sheets.get(style) ?? null
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const ready = sheets.get(style);
    if (ready) {
      setSheet(ready);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    loadSpriteSheet(style)
      .then((s) => {
        sheets.set(style, s);
        if (!cancelled) setSheet(s);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // keep SVG fallback
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [style]);
  return sheet;
}
""")

/**
 * Layers control — Google Maps-style basemap picker docked bottom-left.
 * A thumbnail button labelled "Layers" expands on hover into a tray of
 * style options, each previewed with a small static map.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Map from 'react-map-gl';
import { Box, ButtonBase, Paper, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { Layers as LayersIcon } from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import {
  MAP_STYLE_OPTIONS,
  buildMapStyleUrl,
  getMapStyleOption,
  type MapStyleId,
} from '@/utils/mapStyles';

const THUMB = 64;
const BUTTON = 76;
/** Fixed preview zoom so thumbnails read as "a map" regardless of view. */
const PREVIEW_ZOOM = 12;

interface MapStyleControlProps {
  apiKey?: string;
}

/** Small, non-interactive map preview of a style at the given centre. */
const StylePreview: React.FC<{
  styleId: MapStyleId;
  center: [number, number];
  apiKey?: string;
  size: number;
}> = ({ styleId, center, apiKey, size }) => (
  <Box
    sx={{
      width: size,
      height: size,
      bgcolor: getMapStyleOption(styleId).swatch,
      overflow: 'hidden',
      pointerEvents: 'none',
    }}
  >
    <Map
      mapLib={import('maplibre-gl')}
      mapStyle={buildMapStyleUrl(styleId, { apiKey })}
      initialViewState={{ longitude: center[0], latitude: center[1], zoom: PREVIEW_ZOOM }}
      interactive={false}
      attributionControl={false}
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    />
  </Box>
);

export const MapStyleControl: React.FC<MapStyleControlProps> = ({ apiKey }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const current = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapStyle);
  const viewportCenter = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapViewport.center);

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  // Previews are only created once the tray has been opened, and are then
  // kept mounted so re-opening is instant
  const [previewsMounted, setPreviewsMounted] = useState(false);
  // Snapshot the centre when previews mount so they don't re-render on pan
  const [previewCenter, setPreviewCenter] = useState<[number, number]>(viewportCenter);

  const handleEnter = () => {
    if (!previewsMounted) {
      setPreviewCenter(viewportCenter);
      setPreviewsMounted(true);
    }
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const select = (id: MapStyleId) => {
    dispatch.ui.setMapStyle(id);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <Box
      onMouseEnter={handleEnter}
      onMouseLeave={() => setOpen(false)}
      sx={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: 10,
        bottom: 10,
        zIndex: 5,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'flex-end',
        gap: 1,
      }}
    >
      {/* Layers button: preview of the active style */}
      <ButtonBase
        aria-label="Map layers"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        sx={{
          width: BUTTON,
          height: BUTTON,
          borderRadius: 2,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          border: '2px solid #fff',
          boxShadow: 2,
          bgcolor: getMapStyleOption(current).swatch,
          position: 'relative',
        }}
      >
        {previewsMounted ? (
          <StylePreview
            styleId={current}
            center={previewCenter}
            apiKey={apiKey}
            size={BUTTON}
          />
        ) : (
          <LayersIcon sx={{ color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)', fontSize: 32 }} />
        )}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            px: 0.5,
            py: 0.25,
            bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)',
            color: '#fff',
            fontSize: '0.7rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            textAlign: 'center',
            lineHeight: 1.2,
          }}
        >
          Layers
        </Box>
      </ButtonBase>

      {/* Expanding tray of style options */}
      {open && (
        <Paper
          elevation={4}
          sx={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 1.5,
            px: 1.5,
            py: 1,
            borderRadius: 2,
            bgcolor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.97)',
          }}
        >
          {MAP_STYLE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
            const selected = opt.id === current;
            return (
              <ButtonBase
                key={opt.id}
                onClick={() => select(opt.id)}
                title={opt.id}
                aria-pressed={selected}
                sx={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 0.5,
                  borderRadius: 1.5,
                }}
              >
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: THUMB + 4,
                    height: THUMB + 4,
                    borderRadius: 1.5,
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    border: 2,
                    borderColor: selected ? 'primary.main' : 'transparent',
                    bgcolor: opt.swatch,
                  }}
                >
                  {previewsMounted && (
                    <StylePreview
                      styleId={opt.id}
                      center={previewCenter}
                      apiKey={apiKey}
                      size={THUMB}
                    />
                  )}
                </Box>
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    fontWeight: selected ? 700 : 500,
                    color: selected ? 'primary.main' : 'text.primary',
                    lineHeight: 1,
                  }}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </Typography>
              </ButtonBase>
            );
          })}
        </Paper>
      )}
    </Box>
  );
};

export default MapStyleControl;
EOF
```

```bash
new='''/** Multiplies a numeric value or expression output by SHIELD_SCALE. */
function scaleValue(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v * SHIELD_SCALE;
  return ['*', v, SHIELD_SCALE];
}

/**
 * Scales a layout size value. Zoom-driven `interpolate`/`step` expressions
 * (and legacy `{stops}` functions) are scaled at their outputs, because a
 * `zoom` expression is only valid as the input of a *top-level* interpolate
 * or step — wrapping the whole thing in `*` would invalidate the style.
 */
function scaleLayoutValue(v: unknown, fallback: number): unknown {
  if (v == null) return fallback * SHIELD_SCALE;
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v * SHIELD_SCALE;
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    const op = v[0];
    if (op === 'interpolate' || op === 'interpolate-hcl' || op === 'interpolate-lab') {
      // ['interpolate', interpolation, input, stop, output, stop, output, ...]
      return v.map((item, i) => (i >= 3 && i % 2 === 0 ? scaleValue(item) : item));
    }
    if (op === 'step') {
      // ['step', input, output0, stop1, output1, stop2, output2, ...]
      return v.map((item, i) => (i === 2 || (i >= 3 && i % 2 === 0) ? scaleValue(item) : item));
    }
    return scaleValue(v);
  }
  if (typeof v === 'object' && Array.isArray((v as { stops?: unknown }).stops)) {
    const fn = v as { stops: [number, unknown][] };
    return { ...fn, stops: fn.stops.map(([z, out]) => [z, scaleValue(out)]) };
  }
  return fallback * SHIELD_SCALE;
}

'''
```

```bash
 * The Orbis traffic overlays reference TomTom's own tile hosts with the
 * NextBillion key, which those hosts reject; NextBillion serves the same
 * paths under /orbis, so point the sources there.
 */
const TOMTOM_ORBIS_HOST = /^https:\\/\\/[a-d]\\.api\\.tomtom\\.com\\/maps\\/orbis\\//;
const NB_ORBIS_BASE = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/orbis/';

export function proxyTomTomSources(style: StyleSpecification): StyleSpecification {
  const sources = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(style.sources).map(([id, src]) => {
      if (src.type !== 'vector' && src.type !== 'raster') return [id, src];
      const rewrite = (u: string) => u.replace(TOMTOM_ORBIS_HOST, NB_ORBIS_BASE);
      return [
        id,
        {
          ...src,
          ...(src.tiles ? { tiles: src.tiles.map(rewrite) } : {}),
          ...(src.url ? { url: rewrite(src.url) } : {}),
        },
      ];
    })
  );
  return { ...style, sources };
}

export function thinShields(style: StyleSpecification): StyleSpecification {""")
```

[tool: Bash — Use PNG natural size for sprite sheet; typecheck; compare extents vs real size]
```bash
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/utils/spriteShields.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old_start=s.index("export interface SpriteSheet {")
old_end=s.index("export interface ShieldGlyph")
new='''export interface SpriteSheet {
  url: string;
  meta: Record<string, SpriteIconMeta>;
  /** Sheet dimensions in device pixels. */
  sheetW: number;
  sheetH: number;
}

const cache = new Map<MapStyleId, Promise<SpriteSheet>>();

/** Natural size of an image URL (falls back to null when it can't load). */
function imageSize(url: string): Promise<{ w: number; h: number } | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (typeof Image === 'undefined') {
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => resolve({ w: img.naturalWidth, h: img.naturalHeight });
    img.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    img.src = url;
  });
}

/** Loads (and caches) the sprite sheet of a basemap style. */
export function loadSpriteSheet(
  style: MapStyleId = DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE
): Promise<SpriteSheet> {
  let pending = cache.get(style);
  if (!pending) {
    const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEXTBILLION_API_KEY ?? '';
    const urls = buildSpriteUrls(style, key);
    pending = Promise.all([
      fetch(urls.json).then((r) => {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`sprite fetch failed (${r.status})`);
        return r.json() as Promise<Record<string, SpriteIconMeta>>;
      }),
      imageSize(urls.png),
    ]).then(([raw, size]) => {
      // Expose shield icons by their bare names (the style prefixes them)
      const meta: Record<string, SpriteIconMeta> = {};
      let sheetW = 0;
      let sheetH = 0;
      for (const [name, m] of Object.entries(raw)) {
        meta[
          name.startsWith(SPRITE_SHIELD_PREFIX)
            ? name.slice(SPRITE_SHIELD_PREFIX.length)
            : name
        ] = m;
        sheetW = Math.max(sheetW, m.x + m.width);
        sheetH = Math.max(sheetH, m.y + m.height);
      }
      // Prefer the real image size; icon extents only bound it from below
      if (size) {
        sheetW = size.w;
        sheetH = size.h;
      }
      return { url: urls.png, meta, sheetW, sheetH };
    });
    cache.set(style, pending);
    // Allow a retry on failure instead of caching the rejection
    pending.catch(() => {
      if (cache.get(style) === pending) cache.delete(style);
    });
  }
  return pending;
}

'''
s=s[:old_start]+new+s[old_end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
```

```bash
if block.endswith('  '): block=block[:-2]
s=s[:a]+"      {mapStyle && (\n"+block+"      )}\n"+s[b:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
```

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T14:32:39.167Z)

[tool: Bash — Create POI hover card component and mount it; typecheck]
```bash
cat > src/components/map/PoiHoverCard.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * POI info window — hovering a point of interest on the basemap opens a
 * Google Maps-style card with the POI's map icon, name, category and
 * address, plus quick routing actions. Clicking the POI pins the card.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Popup, useMap } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { Map as MaplibreMap, MapMouseEvent } from 'maplibre-gl';
import { Box, GlobalStyles, IconButton, Tooltip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import {
  Directions as DirectionsIcon,
  AddLocationAlt as AddStopIcon,
  TripOrigin as OriginIcon,
  Close as CloseIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { reverseGeocode } from '@/services/geocoding/geocodingApi';
import { loadSpriteSheet, type SpriteSheet } from '@/utils/spriteShields';
import type { MapStyleId } from '@/utils/mapStyles';

/** Basemap symbol layers that draw POIs (Orbis styles). */
const POI_LAYERS = ['POI', 'POI - Micro'];
/** Half-size of the pick box around the cursor, in px. */
const PICK_PX = 8;
/** Grace period before the card hides once the cursor leaves the POI. */
const HIDE_DELAY_MS = 250;

/** Accent colour per POI group (header band + icon badge). */
const GROUP_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  shopping: '#3949ab',
  food: '#ef6c00',
  food_and_drink: '#ef6c00',
  restaurant: '#ef6c00',
  education: '#8e24aa',
  sport: '#43a047',
  leisure: '#7cb342',
  entertainment: '#8e24aa',
  transport: '#00897b',
  parking: '#546e7a',
  driving: '#455a64',
  healthcare: '#e53935',
  health: '#e53935',
  tourism: '#d81b60',
  accommodation: '#6d4c41',
  services: '#5e35b1',
  finance: '#00838f',
  government: '#757575',
  public: '#757575',
  nature: '#2e7d32',
  protected: '#2e7d32',
  religion: '#795548',
};
const DEFAULT_COLOR = '#1976d2';

interface Poi {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  group: string;
  brand?: string;
  subText?: string;
  popularity?: number;
  /** Sprite icon the basemap renders for this POI. */
  icon: string;
  lngLat: [number, number];
}

interface PoiHoverCardProps {
  /** Set on mousedown over a POI so the map click doesn't add a waypoint. */
  suppressClickRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
}

/** "school_or_kindergarten" -> "School or kindergarten" */
function humanize(s: string): string {
  const t = s.replace(/_/g, ' ').trim();
  return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
}

function toPoi(f: {
  id?: string | number;
  properties: Record<string, unknown>;
  geometry: GeoJSON.Geometry;
  layer: { layout?: Record<string, unknown> };
}): Poi | null {
  if (f.geometry.type !== 'Point') return null;
  const p = f.properties;
  const category = String(p.category ?? '');
  const iconFromStyle = f.layer.layout?.['icon-image'];
  return {
    id: String(p.id ?? f.id ?? `${category}:${p.name}`),
    name: String(p.name ?? p.brand ?? humanize(category) ?? 'Place'),
    category,
    group: String(p.group ?? ''),
    brand: p.brand ? String(p.brand) : undefined,
    subText: p.sub_text ? String(p.sub_text) : undefined,
    popularity: typeof p.popularity === 'number' ? p.popularity : undefined,
    icon: typeof iconFromStyle === 'string' ? iconFromStyle : `poi-${category}`,
    lngLat: [f.geometry.coordinates[0], f.geometry.coordinates[1]],
  };
}

// Addresses by POI id, shared across mounts
const addressCache = new Map<string, string | null>();

/** Sprite sheet of the current basemap style, for the POI icon. */
function useSpriteSheet(style: MapStyleId): SpriteSheet | null {
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<SpriteSheet | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    loadSpriteSheet(style)
      .then((s) => {
        if (!cancelled) setSheet(s);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setSheet(null);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [style]);
  return sheet;
}

/** The POI's own map icon, cropped from the sprite sheet. */
const PoiIcon: React.FC<{ name: string; sheet: SpriteSheet | null; size: number }> = ({
  name,
  sheet,
  size,
}) => {
  const icon = sheet?.meta[name];
  if (!icon || !sheet) return null;
  const pr = icon.pixelRatio || 1;
  const scale = size / Math.max(icon.width, icon.height) * pr;
  const w = (icon.width / pr) * scale;
  const h = (icon.height / pr) * scale;
  return (
    <Box
      component="span"
      role="img"
      aria-hidden
      sx={{
        display: 'block',
        width: w,
        height: h,
        backgroundImage: `url("${sheet.url}")`,
        backgroundRepeat: 'no-repeat',
        backgroundPosition: `${(-icon.x / pr) * scale}px ${(-icon.y / pr) * scale}px`,
        backgroundSize: `${(sheet.sheetW / pr) * scale}px ${(sheet.sheetH / pr) * scale}px`,
      }}
    />
  );
};

export const PoiHoverCard: React.FC<PoiHoverCardProps> = ({ suppressClickRef }) => {
  const { current: mapRef } = useMap();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const styleId = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapStyle);
  const sheet = useSpriteSheet(styleId);

  const [poi, setPoi] = useState<Poi | null>(null);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const [address, setAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Latest state for the map event handlers (registered once per map)
  const latest = useRef({ poi, pinned, suppressClickRef });
  latest.current = { poi, pinned, suppressClickRef };
  const hideTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const cancelHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
      hideTimer.current = null;
    }
  };
  const scheduleHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current || latest.current.pinned) return;
    hideTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      hideTimer.current = null;
      if (!latest.current.pinned) setPoi(null);
    }, HIDE_DELAY_MS);
  };

  // Reverse-geocode the POI for its address (cached by POI id)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!poi) {
      setAddress(null);
      return;
    }
    if (addressCache.has(poi.id)) {
      setAddress(addressCache.get(poi.id) ?? null);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setAddress(null);
    reverseGeocode(poi.lngLat).then((addr) => {
      addressCache.set(poi.id, addr);
      if (!cancelled) setAddress(addr);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [poi]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef?.getMap() as unknown as MaplibreMap | undefined;
    if (!map) return;
    const canvas = map.getCanvas();
    let savedCursor: string | null = null;
    let pendingPin: Poi | null = null;

    const setCursor = (c: string) => {
      if (savedCursor === null) savedCursor = canvas.style.cursor;
      canvas.style.cursor = c;
    };
    const resetCursor = () => {
      if (savedCursor !== null) {
        canvas.style.cursor = savedCursor;
        savedCursor = null;
      }
    };

    const poiAt = (point: { x: number; y: number }): Poi | null => {
      const layers = POI_LAYERS.filter((id) => map.getLayer(id));
      if (!layers.length) return null;
      const feats = map.queryRenderedFeatures(
        [
          [point.x - PICK_PX, point.y - PICK_PX],
          [point.x + PICK_PX, point.y + PICK_PX],
        ],
        { layers }
      );
      for (const f of feats) {
        const p = toPoi(f as unknown as Parameters<typeof toPoi>[0]);
        if (p) return p;
      }
      return null;
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      const hit = poiAt(e.point);
      if (hit) {
        setCursor('pointer');
        cancelHide();
        if (!latest.current.pinned && latest.current.poi?.id !== hit.id) setPoi(hit);
        return;
      }
      resetCursor();
      if (!latest.current.pinned) scheduleHide();
    };

    const onMouseDown = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      if (e.originalEvent.button !== 0) return;
      pendingPin = poiAt(e.point);
      // Clicking a POI opens its card instead of dropping a waypoint
      if (pendingPin) latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = true;
    };
    const onDragStart = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        pendingPin = null;
        latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = false;
      }
    };
    const onClick = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        cancelHide();
        setPoi(pendingPin);
        setPinned(true);
        pendingPin = null;
      } else if (latest.current.pinned) {
        setPinned(false);
        setPoi(null);
      }
    };
    const onMouseOut = () => {
      resetCursor();
      scheduleHide();
    };

    map.on('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    map.on('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    map.on('dragstart', onDragStart);
    map.on('click', onClick);
    map.on('mouseout', onMouseOut);
    return () => {
      map.off('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      map.off('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      map.off('dragstart', onDragStart);
      map.off('click', onClick);
      map.off('mouseout', onMouseOut);
      cancelHide();
      resetCursor();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [mapRef]);

  if (!poi) return null;

  const color = GROUP_COLORS[poi.group] ?? DEFAULT_COLOR;
  const details = [poi.subText ? humanize(poi.subText) : null, humanize(poi.category)]
    .filter((s): s is string => !!s)
    .filter((s, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(s) === i)
    .join(' · ');
  const close = () => {
    setPinned(false);
    setPoi(null);
  };
  const act = (fn: () => void) => {
    fn();
    close();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <GlobalStyles
        styles={{
          '.poi-popup .maplibregl-popup-content': {
            padding: 0,
            borderRadius: 12,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)',
          },
          '.poi-popup .maplibregl-popup-tip': { borderTopColor: '#fff' },
        }}
      />
      <Popup
        longitude={poi.lngLat[0]}
        latitude={poi.lngLat[1]}
        anchor="bottom"
        offset={14}
        closeButton={false}
        closeOnClick={false}
        maxWidth="320px"
        className="poi-popup"
      >
        <Box
          onMouseEnter={cancelHide}
          onMouseLeave={scheduleHide}
          sx={{ width: 300, fontFamily: 'inherit' }}
        >
          {/* Header band with the POI's map icon */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: 'relative',
              height: 84,
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${color} 0%, ${color}cc 100%)`,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 56,
                height: 56,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                bgcolor: '#fff',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
              }}
            >
              <PoiIcon name={poi.icon} sheet={sheet} size={34} />
            </Box>
            {pinned && (
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                aria-label="Close"
                onClick={close}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: 4,
                  right: 4,
                  color: '#fff',
                  bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                  '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' },
                }}
              >
                <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          </Box>

          {/* Body: name, category, address + actions */}
          <Box sx={{ px: 2, py: 1.5, display: 'flex', gap: 1.5, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <Typography variant="subtitle1" fontWeight={700} lineHeight={1.25} noWrap title={poi.name}>
                {poi.name}
              </Typography>
              {poi.brand && poi.brand !== poi.name && (
                <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                  {poi.brand}
                </Typography>
              )}
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" noWrap>
                {details}
              </Typography>
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                color="text.secondary"
                sx={{ display: 'block', whiteSpace: 'normal', mt: 0.25 }}
              >
                {address ?? (addressCache.has(poi.id) ? '' : 'Looking up address…')}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.5, flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <Tooltip title="Directions here" placement="left">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => act(() => dispatch.waypoints.setDestination({ coordinates: poi.lngLat, name: poi.name }))}
                  sx={{ bgcolor: '#e3f2fd', color: 'primary.main', '&:hover': { bgcolor: '#bbdefb' } }}
                >
                  <DirectionsIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip title="Add as stop" placement="left">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => act(() => dispatch.waypoints.addWaypoint({ coordinates: poi.lngLat, name: poi.name }))}
                  sx={{ bgcolor: '#e3f2fd', color: 'primary.main', '&:hover': { bgcolor: '#bbdefb' } }}
                >
                  <AddStopIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
              <Tooltip title="Start from here" placement="left">
                <IconButton
                  size="small"
                  onClick={() => act(() => dispatch.waypoints.setOrigin({ coordinates: poi.lngLat, name: poi.name }))}
                  sx={{ bgcolor: '#e3f2fd', color: 'primary.main', '&:hover': { bgcolor: '#bbdefb' } }}
                >
                  <OriginIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
              </Tooltip>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Popup>
    </>
  );
};

export default PoiHoverCard;
```

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T14:36:34.712Z)

Both requests are done, browser-verified, and committed locally (four commits ahead of `origin/main`, working tree clean).

**Layers control (`d576246`)** — bottom-left thumbnail button labelled "Layers"; hovering expands a tray of five live mini-map previews: **Street** (default, `basic_street-light`), Mono, Satellite, Mono dark, Dark. The selection lives in the store (`ui.mapStyle`), and the traffic toggle now overlays incidents/flow in the light or dark flavour matching the chosen style. Since you'd already switched `MapContainer` to the Orbis endpoint, everything is on `orbis/style/0.4.4-0` — which surfaced three things I had to fix along the way:
- Orbis traffic styles point their tile sources at `a.api.tomtom.com` with the NB key (401). NB serves the same paths under `api.nextbillion.io/orbis/…`, so `proxyTomTomSources()` rewrites them — traffic renders again.
- `thinShields` wrapped shield sizes as `['*', expr, 1.25]`, which is invalid when the inner expression is a zoom `interpolate`. Diffs silently rejected those properties, but a full style rebuild failed validation and left the map on its old style. It now scales the interpolate outputs in place.
- Maneuver-list shields now load the sprite of the selected style (Orbis prefixes icons with `road_shields-`, normalised in the loader).

**maplibre-gl 3.6 (`c67ee99`)** — 2.4 couldn't diff a sprite change, so every basemap switch rebuilt the whole style (blank map meanwhile). 3.x diffs in place; switches are near-instant, and the map also now mounts once the transformed style is ready instead of loading twice at startup. Route, vertex drag, markers, traffic control and shields all re-verified on 3.6.

**POI info window (`2f833f4`)** — hovering a basemap POI opens a Google-style card: group-coloured header with the POI's own sprite icon, name, category (+ brand/sub-type), reverse-geocoded address, and three round actions — *Directions here* (sets destination), *Add as stop*, *Start from here*. Clicking the POI pins the card (close button appears) and doesn't drop a stray waypoint. Ratings, photos and hours aren't in the Orbis POI data, so the card is honest about what the tiles carry.

One thing worth knowing: much of my debugging time went into "stale map" symptoms that turned out to be Chrome pausing `requestAnimationFrame` for the automation tab while its window is occluded — not an app issue. I saved that as a memory note so it doesn't bite again.

Not done: nothing pushed to GitHub or deployed to Cloud Run — say the word and I'll push and run the usual image build → `terraform apply`.

```bash
export function buildMapStyleUrl(
  id: MapStyleId,
  options: { traffic?: boolean; apiKey?: string } = {}
): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ apiVersion: '1', map: id });
  if (options.traffic) {
    const theme = getMapStyleOption(id).dark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    params.set('trafficIncidents', `incidents_${theme}`);
    params.set('trafficFlow', `flow_relative-${theme}`);
  }""","""/** Which traffic overlays to draw on top of the basemap. */
export interface TrafficOverlays {
  /** Live congestion colouring of the road network (trafficFlow). */
  flow: boolean;
  /** Accident / roadworks / closure markers (trafficIncidents). */
  incidents: boolean;
}

/**
 * Full style URL for a basemap, with whichever traffic overlays are
 * enabled (each is an independent style parameter).
 */
export function buildMapStyleUrl(
  id: MapStyleId,
  options: { traffic?: Partial<TrafficOverlays>; apiKey?: string } = {}
): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ apiVersion: '1', map: id });
  const theme = getMapStyleOption(id).dark ? 'dark' : 'light';
  if (options.traffic?.incidents) {
    params.set('trafficIncidents', `incidents_${theme}`);
  }
  if (options.traffic?.flow) {
    params.set('trafficFlow', `flow_relative-${theme}`);
  }""")

 * Traffic overlay toggles - native maplibre control so it stacks and aligns
 * with the navigation control in the map's control corner. Two independent
 * buttons: live traffic flow and traffic incidents.
 */
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useControl } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { IControl } from 'maplibre-gl';
import type { TrafficOverlays } from '@/utils/mapStyles';

// Material Design "Traffic" icon, drawn with currentColor
const FLOW_ICON_SVG = `
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style="display:block">
  <path d="M20 10h-3V8.86c1.72-.45 3-2 3-3.86h-3V4c0-.55-.45-1-1-1H8c-.55 0-1 .45-1 1v1H4c0 1.86 1.28 3.41 3 3.86V10H4c0 1.86 1.28 3.41 3 3.86V15H4c0 1.86 1.28 3.41 3 3.86V20c0 .55.45 1 1 1h8c.55 0 1-.45 1-1v-1.14c1.72-.45 3-2 3-3.86h-3v-1.14c1.72-.45 3-2 3-3.86zm-8 9c-1.11 0-2-.9-2-2s.89-2 2-2c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2s-.89 2-2 2zm0-5c-1.11 0-2-.9-2-2s.89-2 2-2c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2s-.89 2-2 2zm0-5c-1.11 0-2-.9-2-2 0-1.11.89-2 2-2 1.1 0 2 .89 2 2 0 1.1-.89 2-2 2z"/>
</svg>`;

// Material Design "Warning" icon (incidents)
const INCIDENTS_ICON_SVG = `
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style="display:block">
  <path d="M1 21h22L12 2 1 21zm12-3h-2v-2h2v2zm0-4h-2v-4h2v4z"/>
</svg>`;

type OverlayKey = keyof TrafficOverlays;

const BUTTONS: Array<{ key: OverlayKey; label: string; icon: string }> = [
  { key: 'flow', label: 'traffic flow', icon: FLOW_ICON_SVG },
  { key: 'incidents', label: 'traffic incidents', icon: INCIDENTS_ICON_SVG },
];

class TrafficToggleControl implements IControl {
  private container: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private buttons: Partial<Record<OverlayKey, HTMLButtonElement>> = {};

  constructor(private onToggle: (key: OverlayKey) => void) {}

  onAdd(): HTMLElement {
    this.container = document.createElement('div');
    this.container.className = 'maplibregl-ctrl maplibregl-ctrl-group';

    for (const { key, label, icon } of BUTTONS) {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', `Toggle ${label}`);
      button.style.display = 'flex';
      button.style.alignItems = 'center';
      button.style.justifyContent = 'center';
      button.addEventListener('click', () => this.onToggle(key));
      button.innerHTML = icon;
      this.container.appendChild(button);
      this.buttons[key] = button;
    }
    return this.container;
  }

  onRemove(): void {
    this.container?.remove();
    this.container = null;
    this.buttons = {};
  }

  setState(overlays: TrafficOverlays): void {
    for (const { key, label } of BUTTONS) {
      const button = this.buttons[key];
      if (!button) continue;
      const enabled = overlays[key];
      button.title = `${enabled ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${label}`;
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));
      button.style.color = enabled ? '#1976D2' : '#616161';
    }
  }
}

interface TrafficControlProps {
  overlays: TrafficOverlays;
  onToggle: (key: OverlayKey) => void;
}

export function TrafficControl({ overlays, onToggle }: TrafficControlProps) {
  // Keep the latest callback without recreating the control
  const onToggleRef = useRef(onToggle);
  onToggleRef.current = onToggle;

  const control = useControl<TrafficToggleControl>(
    () => new TrafficToggleControl((key) => onToggleRef.current(key)),
    { position: 'top-right' }
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    control.setState(overlays);
  }, [control, overlays]);

  return null;
}

export default TrafficControl;
```

```bash
cat > src/components/map/IncidentHoverCard.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * Traffic incident info window — hovering an incident marker (or its
 * affected road segment) opens a card describing the incident. Details
 * come from the incident tiles (type / severity codes, incident id, road
 * class) and the basemap road under the cursor (road name); clicking pins
 * the card.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Popup, useMap } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { Map as MaplibreMap, MapMouseEvent, MapGeoJSONFeature } from 'maplibre-gl';
import { Box, Chip, GlobalStyles, IconButton, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import {
  Block as ClosedIcon,
  CarCrash as AccidentIcon,
  Construction as RoadworksIcon,
  Traffic as JamIcon,
  Warning as WarningIcon,
  Water as FloodIcon,
  AcUnit as IceIcon,
  Air as WindIcon,
  Cloud as FogIcon,
  Umbrella as RainIcon,
  RemoveRoad as LaneClosedIcon,
  CarRepair as BreakdownIcon,
  Close as CloseIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { formatDistance } from '@/utils/formatting';

/** Prefix of every incident layer in the Orbis traffic styles. */
const INCIDENT_LAYER_PREFIX = 'TrafficIncidents - ';
/** Half-size of the pick box around the cursor, in px. */
const PICK_PX = 8;
const HIDE_DELAY_MS = 250;

/** TomTom incident icon categories. */
const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<number, string> = {
  0: 'Traffic incident',
  1: 'Accident',
  2: 'Fog',
  3: 'Dangerous conditions',
  4: 'Rain',
  5: 'Ice',
  6: 'Traffic jam',
  7: 'Lane closed',
  8: 'Road closed',
  9: 'Road works',
  10: 'Wind',
  11: 'Flooding',
  14: 'Broken-down vehicle',
};

const CATEGORY_ICONS: Record<number, React.ElementType> = {
  1: AccidentIcon,
  2: FogIcon,
  3: WarningIcon,
  4: RainIcon,
  5: IceIcon,
  6: JamIcon,
  7: LaneClosedIcon,
  8: ClosedIcon,
  9: RoadworksIcon,
  10: WindIcon,
  11: FloodIcon,
  14: BreakdownIcon,
};

/** TomTom magnitude-of-delay codes. */
const SEVERITY: Record<number, { label: string; color: string }> = {
  0: { label: 'Delay unknown', color: '#616161' },
  1: { label: 'Minor delay', color: '#f9a825' },
  2: { label: 'Moderate delay', color: '#ef6c00' },
  3: { label: 'Major delay', color: '#d32f2f' },
  4: { label: 'Road closed', color: '#424242' },
};

interface Incident {
  id: string;
  categories: number[];
  magnitude: number;
  roadCategory?: string;
  roadSubcategory?: string;
  /** Where to anchor the card: the marker point, or the cursor on a segment. */
  lngLat: [number, number];
  /** Name of the basemap road under the marker, when known. */
  roadName?: string;
  /** Length of the incident's affected segment currently in view, metres. */
  visibleLengthM?: number;
}

interface IncidentHoverCardProps {
  suppressClickRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
}

const R = 6371008.8;
function segmentLengthM(coords: number[][]): number {
  let d = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < coords.length; i++) {
    const [lng1, lat1] = coords[i - 1];
    const [lng2, lat2] = coords[i];
    const φ1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180;
    const φ2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180;
    const dφ = φ2 - φ1;
    const dλ = ((lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const a = Math.sin(dφ / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) * Math.sin(dλ / 2) ** 2;
    d += 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a));
  }
  return d;
}

function humanize(s: string): string {
  const t = s.replace(/_/g, ' ').trim();
  return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
}

export const IncidentHoverCard: React.FC<IncidentHoverCardProps> = ({ suppressClickRef }) => {
  const { current: mapRef } = useMap();
  const [incident, setIncident] = useState<Incident | null>(null);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);

  const latest = useRef({ incident, pinned, suppressClickRef });
  latest.current = { incident, pinned, suppressClickRef };
  const hideTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const cancelHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
      hideTimer.current = null;
    }
  };
  const scheduleHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current || latest.current.pinned) return;
    hideTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      hideTimer.current = null;
      if (!latest.current.pinned) setIncident(null);
    }, HIDE_DELAY_MS);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef?.getMap() as unknown as MaplibreMap | undefined;
    if (!map) return;
    const canvas = map.getCanvas();
    let savedCursor: string | null = null;
    let pendingPin: Incident | null = null;
    // Incident layer ids, refreshed whenever the style changes
    let markerLayers: string[] = [];
    let lineLayers: string[] = [];
    const refreshLayers = () => {
      const layers = map.getStyle()?.layers ?? [];
      markerLayers = [];
      lineLayers = [];
      for (const l of layers) {
        if (!l.id.startsWith(INCIDENT_LAYER_PREFIX)) continue;
        if (l.type === 'symbol') markerLayers.push(l.id);
        else if (l.type === 'line' && !/outline|pattern/i.test(l.id)) lineLayers.push(l.id);
      }
    };
    refreshLayers();

    const setCursor = (c: string) => {
      if (savedCursor === null) savedCursor = canvas.style.cursor;
      canvas.style.cursor = c;
    };
    const resetCursor = () => {
      if (savedCursor !== null) {
        canvas.style.cursor = savedCursor;
        savedCursor = null;
      }
    };

    const box = (p: { x: number; y: number }): [[number, number], [number, number]] => [
      [p.x - PICK_PX, p.y - PICK_PX],
      [p.x + PICK_PX, p.y + PICK_PX],
    ];

    /** Name of the basemap road nearest the point, if any. */
    const roadNameAt = (p: { x: number; y: number }): string | undefined => {
      const feats = map.queryRenderedFeatures(box(p));
      for (const f of feats) {
        if (f.sourceLayer === 'roads' && typeof f.properties?.name === 'string') {
          return f.properties.name;
        }
      }
      return undefined;
    };

    const toIncident = (f: MapGeoJSONFeature, e: MapMouseEvent): Incident => {
      const p = f.properties ?? {};
      const id = String(p.id ?? '');
      const categories = [p.icon_category_0, p.icon_category_1, p.icon_category_2]
        .filter((c): c is number => typeof c === 'number');
      const lngLat: [number, number] =
        f.geometry.type === 'Point'
          ? [f.geometry.coordinates[0], f.geometry.coordinates[1]]
          : [e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat];
      // Affected segment(s) of this incident currently rendered
      let visibleLengthM = 0;
      if (id && lineLayers.length) {
        const segs = map.queryRenderedFeatures(undefined as never, {
          layers: lineLayers.filter((l) => map.getLayer(l)),
          filter: ['==', ['get', 'id'], id],
        });
        const seen = new Set<string>();
        for (const s of segs) {
          if (s.geometry.type !== 'LineString') continue;
          const key = JSON.stringify(s.geometry.coordinates[0]) + s.geometry.coordinates.length;
          if (seen.has(key)) continue;
          seen.add(key);
          visibleLengthM += segmentLengthM(s.geometry.coordinates);
        }
      }
      return {
        id,
        categories: categories.length ? categories : [0],
        magnitude: typeof p.magnitude_of_delay === 'number' ? p.magnitude_of_delay : 0,
        roadCategory: typeof p.road_category === 'string' ? p.road_category : undefined,
        roadSubcategory: typeof p.road_subcategory === 'string' ? p.road_subcategory : undefined,
        lngLat,
        roadName: roadNameAt(e.point),
        visibleLengthM: visibleLengthM || undefined,
      };
    };

    const incidentAt = (e: MapMouseEvent): Incident | null => {
      const layers = [...markerLayers, ...lineLayers].filter((l) => map.getLayer(l));
      if (!layers.length) return null;
      const feats = map.queryRenderedFeatures(box(e.point), { layers });
      // Prefer markers over segments
      const f =
        feats.find((x) => x.geometry.type === 'Point') ?? feats[0];
      return f ? toIncident(f, e) : null;
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      const hit = incidentAt(e);
      if (hit) {
        setCursor('pointer');
        cancelHide();
        if (!latest.current.pinned && latest.current.incident?.id !== hit.id) setIncident(hit);
        return;
      }
      resetCursor();
      if (!latest.current.pinned) scheduleHide();
    };
    const onMouseDown = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      if (e.originalEvent.button !== 0) return;
      pendingPin = incidentAt(e);
      if (pendingPin) latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = true;
    };
    const onDragStart = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        pendingPin = null;
        latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = false;
      }
    };
    const onClick = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        cancelHide();
        setIncident(pendingPin);
        setPinned(true);
        pendingPin = null;
      } else if (latest.current.pinned) {
        setPinned(false);
        setIncident(null);
      }
    };
    const onMouseOut = () => {
      resetCursor();
      scheduleHide();
    };

    map.on('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    map.on('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    map.on('dragstart', onDragStart);
    map.on('click', onClick);
    map.on('mouseout', onMouseOut);
    map.on('styledata', refreshLayers);
    return () => {
      map.off('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      map.off('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      map.off('dragstart', onDragStart);
      map.off('click', onClick);
      map.off('mouseout', onMouseOut);
      map.off('styledata', refreshLayers);
      cancelHide();
      resetCursor();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [mapRef]);

  if (!incident) return null;

  const primary = incident.categories[0];
  const sev = SEVERITY[incident.magnitude] ?? SEVERITY[0];
  const color = primary === 8 ? SEVERITY[4].color : sev.color;
  const Icon = CATEGORY_ICONS[primary] ?? WarningIcon;
  const title = CATEGORY_LABELS[primary] ?? CATEGORY_LABELS[0];
  const extra = incident.categories
    .slice(1)
    .map((c) => CATEGORY_LABELS[c])
    .filter((s): s is string => !!s && s !== title);
  const road = [
    incident.roadName,
    incident.roadSubcategory
      ? humanize(incident.roadSubcategory)
      : incident.roadCategory
        ? humanize(incident.roadCategory)
        : null,
  ]
    .filter((s): s is string => !!s)
    .join(' · ');
  const close = () => {
    setPinned(false);
    setIncident(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <GlobalStyles
        styles={{
          '.incident-popup .maplibregl-popup-content': {
            padding: 0,
            borderRadius: 12,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)',
          },
          '.incident-popup .maplibregl-popup-tip': { borderTopColor: '#fff' },
        }}
      />
      <Popup
        longitude={incident.lngLat[0]}
        latitude={incident.lngLat[1]}
        anchor="bottom"
        offset={14}
        closeButton={false}
        closeOnClick={false}
        maxWidth="320px"
        className="incident-popup"
      >
        <Box onMouseEnter={cancelHide} onMouseLeave={scheduleHide} sx={{ width: 290 }}>
          {/* Header band coloured by severity */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: 'relative',
              height: 72,
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${color} 0%, ${color}cc 100%)`,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                width: 52,
                height: 52,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                bgcolor: '#fff',
                color,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',
              }}
            >
              <Icon sx={{ fontSize: 30 }} />
            </Box>
            {pinned && (
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                aria-label="Close"
                onClick={close}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: 4,
                  right: 4,
                  color: '#fff',
                  bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                  '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' },
                }}
              >
                <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          </Box>

          <Box sx={{ px: 2, py: 1.5 }}>
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" fontWeight={700} lineHeight={1.25}>
              {title}
              {extra.length > 0 && (
                <Typography component="span" variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                  {' '}
                  · {extra.join(' · ')}
                </Typography>
              )}
            </Typography>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 0.75, flexWrap: 'wrap', mt: 0.75, mb: 0.75 }}>
              <Chip
                size="small"
                label={primary === 8 ? 'Closed' : sev.label}
                sx={{ bgcolor: color, color: '#fff', fontWeight: 600, height: 22 }}
              />
              {incident.visibleLengthM && (
                <Chip
                  size="small"
                  variant="outlined"
                  label={`${formatDistance(incident.visibleLengthM)} affected in view`}
                  sx={{ height: 22 }}
                />
              )}
            </Box>
            {road && (
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary" noWrap title={road}>
                {road}
              </Typography>
            )}
            {incident.id && (
              <Typography
                variant="caption"
                color="text.disabled"
                sx={{ display: 'block', fontFamily: 'monospace', mt: 0.5 }}
                noWrap
                title={incident.id}
              >
                {incident.id.replace(/^TTI-[0-9a-f-]+-/, '')}
              </Typography>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Popup>
    </>
  );
};

export default IncidentHoverCard;
EOF
```

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T15:46:45.217Z)

Done — committed as `7efea91`, working tree clean.

**Incident info window** (`src/components/map/IncidentHoverCard.tsx`, mounted in `MapContainer`)
- Hovering an incident **marker** or its **affected road segment** (any `TrafficIncidents - …` layer in the Orbis traffic style) opens a card; clicking pins it (close button), and the click doesn't drop a waypoint.
- Header band is coloured by severity with a type icon (road closed, jam, accident, roadworks, lane closed, weather, breakdown…).
- Body shows: incident type + any secondary types, a severity chip (Minor/Moderate/Major delay or Closed), the length of the incident's segment currently in view, the basemap road name and class under the cursor (e.g. "Washington St · Tertiary"), and the TomTom incident id.

**What the data allows** — the incident tiles only carry codes (`icon_category`, `magnitude_of_delay`, road class, id); I probed NB for a proxy of TomTom's incident-details service (descriptions, from/to, delay seconds, times) under `/orbis/traffic/incidentDetails` and `/tt/traffic/services/5/incidentDetails` and got 404s on every spelling, so those fields aren't available through NB today. If NB exposes that endpoint later, the card has an `id` to look it up with.

**Verified in Chrome**: "Traffic jam · Moderate delay · 719 m affected in view · Avenue of the Americas · Secondary" from a segment hover, and "Road closed · Closed · 1.7 km affected in view · Washington St · Tertiary" from a marker hover + pin. Console clean apart from the known extension hydration warning.

`main` is now seven commits ahead of `origin/main` (vertex drag, Layers, maplibre 3.6, POI card, traffic split, incident card) — unpushed and undeployed until you ask.

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T15:52:49.105Z)

Done — committed as `0aaca87`. POI cards now open only when the map zoom is ≥ 14 (`MIN_ZOOM` in `PoiHoverCard.tsx`); below that, hovering POIs is ignored, and an already-open card closes if you zoom back out past the threshold. Verified with the deterministic zoom path: "Locate on map" (exactly z14) → hovering Coviello Plaza opened the card; one "−" (z13) → no card.

**On your question — is the delay duration available?** Not through NextBillion today.

- The incident **tiles** only carry `magnitude_of_delay` as a 0–4 category (unknown / minor / moderate / major / closed) plus the icon-category codes, road class and the incident id — that's what the "Major delay" chip is built from. There is no seconds value in them.
- The actual delay (`delay` in seconds), affected `length`, `from`/`to`, event descriptions and start/end times come from TomTom's **Incident Details** service (`…/traffic/services/5/incidentDetails?ids=…` or the Orbis `…/traffic/incidentDetails`). I probed NB for a proxy of it under `/orbis/traffic/incidentDetails`, `/tt/traffic/services/5/incidentDetails` and a couple of other spellings — all 404, so NB doesn't expose it right now.

The card already keeps the TomTom incident `id` (the `TTL…`/`TTR…` string at the bottom), so the moment an endpoint is available — either NB adding the proxy, or a direct TomTom key for this app — I can look each incident up and show delay minutes, affected length, from→to and the description in the card. That's the only remaining gap; the rest of the incident card is done.

Local `main` is now nine commits ahead of `origin/main`, still unpushed and undeployed until you ask.

```bash
("""/**
 * Formats distance in meters to human-readable string
 */
export function formatDistance(meters: number): string {
  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
  }

  const km = meters / 1000;
  if (km < 10) {
    return `${km.toFixed(1)} km`;
  }

  return `${Math.round(km)} km`;
}
""","""export type DistanceUnits = 'metric' | 'imperial';

const FEET_PER_METER = 3.28084;
const METERS_PER_MILE = 1609.344;

/**
 * Formats distance in meters to a human-readable string in the given units
 * (metric: m / km, imperial: ft / mi).
 */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  units: DistanceUnits = 'metric'
): string {
  if (units === 'imperial') {
    const miles = meters / METERS_PER_MILE;
    if (miles < 0.1) {
      // Short hops in feet, rounded to 10 ft
      return `${Math.round((meters * FEET_PER_METER) / 10) * 10} ft`;
    }
    if (miles < 10) {
      return `${miles.toFixed(1)} mi`;
    }
    return `${Math.round(miles)} mi`;
  }

  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
  }

  const km = meters / 1000;
  if (km < 10) {
    return `${km.toFixed(1)} km`;
  }

  return `${Math.round(km)} km`;
}
"""),
])

'use client';

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { formatDistance as formatDistanceIn, formatDuration } from '@/utils/formatting';

export function useFormatters() {
  const units = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.units);
  const formatDistance = useCallback(
    (meters: number) => formatDistanceIn(meters, units),
    [units]
  );
  return { units, formatDistance, formatDuration };
}
''')
```

**Dark mode follows the basemap (`3a9dec2`)**
- `ThemeProvider` now reads `ui.mapStyle` and builds the MUI theme with `palette.mode: 'dark'` whenever the selected style is a dark one (Satellite, Mono dark, Dark) — light otherwise. Switching styles in the Layers tray flips the whole UI instantly.

Header goes dark too for consistency.
- Verified with the **Dark** style: sidebar, route summary and the Directions panel all render in dark mode; shields come from the dark-style sprite and stay legible.

**Units setting (`0cb0336`)**
- The header gear (previously unwired) opens a Settings popover with a **Units** toggle: *Metric (km)* — default — or *Imperial (mi)*. Stored in `ui.units`.
- All distances format through a units-aware helper (`useFormatters()`): route summary, leg chips, Directions header and steps, maneuver popups, and the incident card's "affected in view" length. Imperial renders short hops in feet (rounded to 10 ft), then miles with one decimal under 10 mi.
- Verified: after choosing Imperial, the summary read "16 mi · 42 min" and steps showed "260 ft", "0.2 mi", "2.2 mi"; the popover reopens with Imperial selected.

```bash
/**
 * Supported UI locales. `navLang` is the value the NextBillion Navigation
 * API accepts for instruction text (it understands base languages plus
 * pt-BR, but not regional variants like fr-CA or es-MX).
 */
export type Locale =
  | 'en-US'
  | 'en-CA'
  | 'en-GB'
  | 'fr-CA'
  | 'es-MX'
  | 'pt-BR'
  | 'ar-SA';

export interface LocaleInfo {
  id: Locale;
  /** Native-language label shown in the selector. */
  label: string;
  dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl';
  /** `lang` parameter for the Navigation API. */
  navLang: string;
}

export const LOCALES: LocaleInfo[] = [
  { id: 'en-US', label: 'English (US)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'en' },
  { id: 'en-CA', label: 'English (Canada)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'en' },
  { id: 'en-GB', label: 'English (UK)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'en' },
  { id: 'fr-CA', label: 'Français (Canada)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'fr' },
  { id: 'es-MX', label: 'Español (México)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'es' },
  { id: 'pt-BR', label: 'Português (Brasil)', dir: 'ltr', navLang: 'pt-BR' },
  { id: 'ar-SA', label: 'العربية (السعودية)', dir: 'rtl', navLang: 'ar' },
];

export const DEFAULT_LOCALE: Locale = 'en-US';

export function getLocaleInfo(id: Locale): LocaleInfo {
  return LOCALES.find((l) => l.id === id) ?? LOCALES[0];
}
EOF

/**
 * Minimal i18n: typed message dictionaries per locale, with {placeholder}
 * interpolation and fall-back to US English for any missing key.
 */
import { enUS, type MessageKey, type Messages } from './messages/en-US';
import { enCA } from './messages/en-CA';
import { enGB } from './messages/en-GB';
import { frCA } from './messages/fr-CA';
import { esMX } from './messages/es-MX';
import { ptBR } from './messages/pt-BR';
import { arSA } from './messages/ar-SA';
import type { Locale } from './locales';

export type { MessageKey, Messages };
export * from './locales';

const OVERRIDES: Record<Locale, Partial<Messages>> = {
  'en-US': {},
  'en-CA': enCA,
  'en-GB': enGB,
  'fr-CA': frCA,
  'es-MX': esMX,
  'pt-BR': ptBR,
  'ar-SA': arSA,
};

const cache = new Map<Locale, Messages>();

export function getMessages(locale: Locale): Messages {
  let m = cache.get(locale);
  if (!m) {
    m = { ...enUS, ...OVERRIDES[locale] } as Messages;
    cache.set(locale, m);
  }
  return m;
}

export type Translate = (
  key: MessageKey,
  vars?: Record<string, string | number>
) => string;

export function translate(
  messages: Messages,
  key: MessageKey,
  vars?: Record<string, string | number>
): string {
  const template = messages[key] ?? enUS[key] ?? key;
  if (!vars) return template;
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, name: string) =>
    name in vars ? String(vars[name]) : `{${name}}`
  );
}

cat > src/hooks/useT.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * UI translation hook bound to the selected language.
 */
'use client';

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import {
  getLocaleInfo,
  getMessages,
  translate,
  type MessageKey,
  type Translate,
} from '@/i18n';

export function useT() {
  const locale = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.language);
  const messages = useMemo(() => getMessages(locale), [locale]);
  const t: Translate = useCallback(
    (key: MessageKey, vars?: Record<string, string | number>) =>
      translate(messages, key, vars),
    [messages]
  );
  const info = getLocaleInfo(locale);
  return { t, locale, dir: info.dir, navLang: info.navLang };
}
```

```bash
sub('src/utils/formatting.ts', [
("""export type DistanceUnits = 'metric' | 'imperial';

const FEET_PER_METER = 3.28084;
const METERS_PER_MILE = 1609.344;

/**
 * Formats distance in meters to a human-readable string in the given units
 * (metric: m / km, imperial: ft / mi).
 */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  units: DistanceUnits = 'metric'
): string {
  if (units === 'imperial') {
    const miles = meters / METERS_PER_MILE;
    if (miles < 0.1) {
      // Short hops in feet, rounded to 10 ft
      return `${Math.round((meters * FEET_PER_METER) / 10) * 10} ft`;
    }
    if (miles < 10) {
      return `${miles.toFixed(1)} mi`;
    }
    return `${Math.round(miles)} mi`;
  }

  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
  }

  const km = meters / 1000;
  if (km < 10) {
    return `${km.toFixed(1)} km`;
  }

  return `${Math.round(km)} km`;
}

/**
 * Formats duration in seconds to human-readable string
 */
export function formatDuration(seconds: number): string {
  const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.round((seconds % 3600) / 60);

  if (hours === 0) {
    return `${minutes} min`;
  }

  if (minutes === 0) {
    return `${hours}h`;
  }

  return `${hours}h ${minutes}min`;
}
""","""export type DistanceUnits = 'metric' | 'imperial';

/** Unit labels, overridable per language. */
export interface UnitLabels {
  m: string;
  km: string;
  ft: string;
  mi: string;
  min: string;
  h: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_UNIT_LABELS: UnitLabels = {
  m: 'm',
  km: 'km',
  ft: 'ft',
  mi: 'mi',
  min: 'min',
  h: 'h',
};

export interface FormatOptions {
  units?: DistanceUnits;
  /** BCP-47 locale for number formatting (decimal separators, digits). */
  locale?: string;
  labels?: UnitLabels;
}

const FEET_PER_METER = 3.28084;
const METERS_PER_MILE = 1609.344;

function num(value: number, locale: string | undefined, fractionDigits: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    minimumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
    maximumFractionDigits: fractionDigits,
  }).format(value);
}

/**
 * Formats distance in meters to a human-readable string in the given units
 * (metric: m / km, imperial: ft / mi), with locale-aware numbers.
 */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  unitsOrOptions: DistanceUnits | FormatOptions = 'metric'
): string {
  const opts: FormatOptions =
    typeof unitsOrOptions === 'string' ? { units: unitsOrOptions } : unitsOrOptions;
  const units = opts.units ?? 'metric';
  const locale = opts.locale;
  const L = opts.labels ?? DEFAULT_UNIT_LABELS;

  if (units === 'imperial') {
    const miles = meters / METERS_PER_MILE;
    if (miles < 0.1) {
      // Short hops in feet, rounded to 10 ft
      return `${num(Math.round((meters * FEET_PER_METER) / 10) * 10, locale, 0)} ${L.ft}`;
    }
    if (miles < 10) {
      return `${num(miles, locale, 1)} ${L.mi}`;
    }
    return `${num(Math.round(miles), locale, 0)} ${L.mi}`;
  }

  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${num(Math.round(meters), locale, 0)} ${L.m}`;
  }

  const km = meters / 1000;
  if (km < 10) {
    return `${num(km, locale, 1)} ${L.km}`;
  }

  return `${num(Math.round(km), locale, 0)} ${L.km}`;
}

/**
 * Formats duration in seconds to human-readable string
 */
export function formatDuration(
  seconds: number,
  options: FormatOptions = {}
): string {
  const L = options.labels ?? DEFAULT_UNIT_LABELS;
  const locale = options.locale;
  const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.round((seconds % 3600) / 60);

  if (hours === 0) {
    return `${num(minutes, locale, 0)} ${L.min}`;
  }

  if (minutes === 0) {
    return `${num(hours, locale, 0)}${L.h}`;
  }

  return `${num(hours, locale, 0)}${L.h} ${num(minutes, locale, 0)}${L.min}`;
}
"""),

open('src/hooks/useFormatters.ts','w').write('''/**
 * Display formatters bound to the user's unit and language preferences.
 */
'use client';

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import {
  formatDistance as formatDistanceIn,
  formatDuration as formatDurationIn,
  type UnitLabels,
} from '@/utils/formatting';
import { getMessages } from '@/i18n';

export function useFormatters() {
  const units = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.units);
  const locale = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.language);
  const labels = useMemo<UnitLabels>(() => {
    const m = getMessages(locale);
    return {
      m: m['units.m'],
      km: m['units.km'],
      ft: m['units.ft'],
      mi: m['units.mi'],
      min: m['units.min'],
      h: m['units.h'],
    };
  }, [locale]);
  const formatDistance = useCallback(
    (meters: number) => formatDistanceIn(meters, { units, locale, labels }),
    [units, locale, labels]
  );
  const formatDuration = useCallback(
    (seconds: number) => formatDurationIn(seconds, { locale, labels }),
    [locale, labels]
  );
  return { units, locale, formatDistance, formatDuration };
}
''')

sub('src/components/sidebar/DirectionsPanel.tsx', [
("""import { fetchNavigation } from '@/services/routing/navigationApi';
""","""import { fetchNavigation } from '@/services/routing/navigationApi';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/useT';
"""),
("""  const nav = useAppSelector((state) => state.route.navigation);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<NavStatus>('idle');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Route changed → previous instructions are stale (the store clears
  // navigation on setResult; reset the panel's request state to match)
  useEffect(() => {
    setStatus('idle');
    setError(null);
  }, [result]);

  if (!result) {
    return null;
  }

  const canNavigate = !!(origin && destination);

  const handleGetDirections = async () => {
    if (!origin || !destination) return;
    setStatus('loading');
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Same request parameters as the directions call
      const navResult = await fetchNavigation({
        origin: origin.coordinates,
        destination: destination.coordinates,
        waypoints: intermediates.map((wp) => wp.coordinates),
        options,
      });
      dispatch.route.setNavigation(navResult);
      setStatus('idle');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Navigation request failed');
      setStatus('error');
    }
  };
""","""  const nav = useAppSelector((state) => state.route.navigation);
  const { t, navLang } = useT();

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<NavStatus>('idle');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Route changed → previous instructions are stale (the store clears
  // navigation on setResult; reset the panel's request state to match)
  useEffect(() => {
    setStatus('idle');
    setError(null);
  }, [result]);

  const canNavigate = !!(origin && destination);

  const handleGetDirections = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!origin || !destination) return;
    setStatus('loading');
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Same request parameters as the directions call, in the UI language
      const navResult = await fetchNavigation(
        {
          origin: origin.coordinates,
          destination: destination.coordinates,
          waypoints: intermediates.map((wp) => wp.coordinates),
          options,
        },
        navLang
      );
      dispatch.route.setNavigation(navResult);
      setStatus('idle');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : t('directions.failed'));
      setStatus('error');
    }
  }, [origin, destination, intermediates, options, navLang, dispatch, t]);

  // Language changed while instructions are shown → fetch them again in
  // the new language
  const hasNav = !!nav;
  const prevLang = useRef(navLang);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevLang.current !== navLang) {
      prevLang.current = navLang;
      if (hasNav) void handleGetDirections();
    }
  }, [navLang, hasNav, handleGetDirections]);

  if (!result) {
    return null;
  }
"""),
```

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T16:14:12.918Z)

Done — committed as `9a19113`, working tree clean, console clean.

**Language setting** — Settings (gear) now has a **Language** selector alongside Units, with native labels: English (US) *default*, English (Canada), English (UK), Français (Canada), Español (México), Português (Brasil), العربية (السعودية). One note on naming: "en-UK" isn't a valid BCP-47 tag, so the code uses `en-GB` (labelled "English (UK)").

**What changing it does**
- **UI i18n** — every visible string goes through a small typed i18n layer (`src/i18n/`): one message catalog per locale, US English as fallback, `{placeholder}` interpolation, and a `useT()` hook. Covered: header, settings, waypoint cards, routing options (modes, avoid/exclude features, route type, departure, truck fields), route summary/legs, Directions panel and overlay (tolls, steps, lane guidance, "arrive"), API panel, map hint, Layers control, traffic button tooltips, POI card actions, and incident types/severities. Numbers format with `Intl` per locale (e.g. "3,5 km" in fr-CA; Arabic-Indic digits in ar-SA), and unit labels translate too ("pi", "pies", "كم").
- **Navigation API** — the request carries `lang=` mapped to what NB actually accepts (I probed all seven: it honours `en`, `fr`, `es`, `pt-BR`, `ar` but returns English for `fr-CA`/`es-MX`/`ar-SA`), so fr-CA → `fr`, es-MX → `es`, ar-SA → `ar`, the English variants → `en`. If directions are already open when you change language, they're re-fetched automatically in the new language.
- **RTL** — Arabic sets `<html dir="rtl" lang="ar-SA">`, switches the MUI theme direction, and swaps in an emotion cache with `stylis-plugin-rtl` so MUI's own margins/positions mirror. `stylis` + `stylis-plugin-rtl` were added as dependencies.

**Verified in Chrome**: French — whole UI translated, `lang=fr` on the navigation request, instructions like "Se diriger vers le nord"; Arabic — mirrored layout (sidebar right, Directions panel left), auto-refetched Arabic instructions, localized digits.

```bash
/**
 * API Route: Proxy to the NextBillion.ai Orbis Discover (place search) API
 * Protects the API key; forwards q, at (search bias) and limit.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const NB_API_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const NB_API_BASE = 'https://api.nextbillion.io';

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!NB_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'API key not configured' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  const { searchParams } = request.nextUrl;
  const q = searchParams.get('q')?.trim();
  const at = searchParams.get('at');
  if (!q) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'Missing "q" parameter' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams({ q, key: NB_API_KEY });
  if (at) params.set('at', at);
  const limit = searchParams.get('limit');
  if (limit) params.set('limit', limit);

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${NB_API_BASE}/orbis/discover?${params}`, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Discover API error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'Failed to search places' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Place search (Orbis Discover)

export interface PlaceSuggestion {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  address: string;
  category?: string;
  /** [lng, lat] */
  coordinates: [number, number];
  /** Metres from the search bias point, when provided by the API. */
  distanceM?: number;
}

interface DiscoverResponse {
  items?: Array<{
    id?: string;
    title?: string;
    address?: { label?: string };
    position?: { lat: number; lng: number };
    categories?: Array<{ name?: string; primary?: boolean }>;
    distance?: number;
  }>;
}

/**
 * Searches places and addresses matching `query`, biased towards `at`
 * ([lng, lat], typically the map centre). Returns [] on failure.
 */
export async function discoverPlaces(
  query: string,
  at: [number, number] | null,
  options: { limit?: number; signal?: AbortSignal } = {}
): Promise<PlaceSuggestion[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ q: query });
  if (at) params.set('at', `${at[1]},${at[0]}`);
  params.set('limit', String(options.limit ?? 6));

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/geocoding/discover?${params}`, {
      signal: options.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) return [];
    const data: DiscoverResponse = await response.json();
    return (data.items ?? [])
      .filter((it) => it.position && typeof it.position.lat === 'number')
      .map((it, i) => ({
        id: it.id ?? `${i}`,
        title: it.title ?? it.address?.label ?? query,
        address: it.address?.label ?? '',
        category:
          it.categories?.find((c) => c.primary)?.name ?? it.categories?.[0]?.name,
        coordinates: [it.position!.lng, it.position!.lat] as [number, number],
        distanceM: typeof it.distance === 'number' ? it.distance : undefined,
      }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}
EOF
```
