/**
 * Place / address autocomplete backed by the NextBillion Discover API,
 * biased to the current map centre.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Autocomplete,
  Box,
  CircularProgress,
  TextField,
  Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import { Place as PlaceIcon } from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { useFormatters } from '@/hooks/useFormatters';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/useT';
import { discoverPlaces, type PlaceSuggestion } from '@/services/geocoding/geocodingApi';

const DEBOUNCE_MS = 250;
const MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2;

interface PlaceSearchProps {
  /** Current display value (the waypoint name), if any. */
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  onSelect: (place: PlaceSuggestion) => void;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}

export const PlaceSearch: React.FC<PlaceSearchProps> = ({
  value = '',
  placeholder,
  onSelect,
  autoFocus,
}) => {
  const { t } = useT();
  const { formatDistance } = useFormatters();
  // Search bias: the centre of the current map view
  const center = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapViewport.center);

  const [input, setInput] = useState(value);
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<PlaceSuggestion[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  // Only search for text the user typed, not the value we display
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);

  // Follow external name changes (map click, reverse geocode, drag)
  useEffect(() => {
    setInput(value);
    setDirty(false);
  }, [value]);

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    const q = input.trim();
    if (q.length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) {
      setOptions([]);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;
      const results = await discoverPlaces(q, center, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setOptions(results);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // The bias point is read when the query changes; no need to re-search on pan
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [input, dirty]);

  useEffect(() => () => abortRef.current?.abort(), []);

  return (
    <Autocomplete<PlaceSuggestion, false, true, true>
      freeSolo
      disableClearable
      size="small"
      open={open && dirty && input.trim().length >= MIN_QUERY_LENGTH}
      onOpen={() => setOpen(true)}
      onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      options={options}
      loading={loading}
      // Options are already ranked by the API
      filterOptions={(x) => x}
      inputValue={input}
      onInputChange={(_, newInput, reason) => {
        if (reason === 'input') {
          setInput(newInput);
          setDirty(true);
        } else if (reason === 'clear') {
          setInput('');
          setDirty(true);
        }
      }}
      getOptionLabel={(opt) => (typeof opt === 'string' ? opt : opt.title)}
      isOptionEqualToValue={(a, b) => a.id === b.id}
      onChange={(_, selected) => {
        if (selected && typeof selected !== 'string') {
          setInput(selected.title);
          setDirty(false);
          setOptions([]);
          onSelect(selected);
        }
      }}
      noOptionsText={loading ? t('waypoints.searching') : t('waypoints.noResults')}
      loadingText={t('waypoints.searching')}
      renderOption={(props, opt) => {
        const { key, ...rest } = props as typeof props & { key: string };
        return (
          <Box component="li" key={key} {...rest} sx={{ alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 1 }}>
            <PlaceIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', mt: 0.25 }} />
            <Box sx={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight={500} noWrap>
                {opt.title}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap display="block">
                {[opt.category, opt.address].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                {opt.distanceM != null ? ` · ${formatDistance(opt.distanceM)}` : ''}
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Box>
        );
      }}
      renderInput={(params) => (
        <TextField
          {...params}
          variant="standard"
          placeholder={placeholder ?? t('waypoints.search')}
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
          InputProps={{
            ...params.InputProps,
            disableUnderline: true,
            sx: { fontSize: '0.875rem', fontWeight: 500 },
            endAdornment: loading ? (
              <CircularProgress size={14} sx={{ mr: 0.5 }} />
            ) : null,
          }}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
};

export default PlaceSearch;
EOF

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T16:56:54.936Z)

Done — committed as `4198237`, working tree clean.

**Place / address autocomplete on every waypoint card**
- Each Origin, Waypoint and Destination card now has a search box (`src/components/sidebar/PlaceSearch.tsx`, MUI Autocomplete). Typing ≥2 characters queries the NextBillion **Orbis Discover** API, debounced at 250 ms with in-flight requests aborted as you keep typing.
- **Search bias**: every request carries `at=<lat>,<lng>` set to the centre of the current map view (the bounding-box centroid, from `ui.mapViewport.center`), plus `limit=6`. Verified in the page: all three discover calls had `&at=` and `limit=`, and results ranked local ("Empire State Building" first, Madison Square Garden variants, Central Park venues).
- Suggestions show the name, category, address and distance from the bias point (in your chosen units); the popper is widened past the compact card so addresses aren't truncated.
- Selecting a result sets a new origin/destination or moves an existing waypoint/stop, names it after the place, and centres the map on it. Map-click placement is unchanged, and the caption still says "Click on map to set origin/destination" / "or click the map" until a location is set.
- The API key stays server-side via a new proxy route `src/app/api/geocoding/discover/route.ts`; the client lives in `discoverPlaces()` in `geocodingApi.ts`. New strings ("Search a place or address", "Searching…", "No places found", "or click the map") are translated in all seven locales.
- One bug caught and fixed during testing: MUI keys options by label, and Discover returned two "Empire State of Wine" listings → duplicate-key warning; options are now keyed by place `id`.

**Verified in Chrome**: origin from "empire state", destination from "madison square garden", intermediate stop from "central park" → route A→1→B calculated; console clean apart from the known extension warning.

`main` is now 14 commits ahead of `origin/main` — still unpushed and undeployed until you ask.

 * Pins for the suggestions of an open place search. The suggestion under
 * the cursor (or keyboard focus) in the list is enlarged, coloured and
 * labelled so it stands out from the others.
 */
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Marker } from 'react-map-gl';
import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';

export const SearchResultMarkers: React.FC = () => {
  const results = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.searchResults);
  const highlightId = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.searchHighlightId);

  if (results.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {results.map((r) => {
        const active = r.id === highlightId;
        return (
          <Marker
            key={r.id}
            longitude={r.coordinates[0]}
            latitude={r.coordinates[1]}
            anchor="center"
            style={{ zIndex: active ? 3 : 2, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
          >
            <Box
              sx={{
                position: 'relative',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
            >
              {/* Pin */}
              <Box
                sx={{
                  width: active ? 22 : 12,
                  height: active ? 22 : 12,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  bgcolor: active ? 'primary.main' : '#9e9e9e',
                  border: '2px solid #fff',
                  boxShadow: active
                    ? '0 0 0 4px rgba(25,118,210,0.25), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'
                    : '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
                  opacity: active ? 1 : 0.85,
                  transition: 'width 120ms, height 120ms, background-color 120ms',
                }}
              />
              {/* Label for the highlighted suggestion */}
              {active && (
                <Typography
                  variant="caption"
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '100%',
                    mt: 0.5,
                    px: 0.75,
                    py: 0.25,
                    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                    bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                    color: 'text.primary',
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    boxShadow: 2,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    lineHeight: 1.3,
                  }}
                >
                  {r.title}
                </Typography>
              )}
            </Box>
          </Marker>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

export default SearchResultMarkers;
''')

cat > src/utils/poiCategories.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * POI category dictionary and map filter.
 *
 * The Orbis styles render one sprite icon per POI category ("poi-<category>"),
 * so the sprite sheet enumerates TomTom's POI category dictionary. Group-level
 * generics (which also ship "-micro"/"-mini" variants) and transit modality
 * variants are not categories and are skipped.
 */
import type { LayerSpecification, StyleSpecification } from 'maplibre-gl';

const POI_PREFIX = 'poi-';
const VARIANT_SUFFIX = /-(micro|mini|bus|ferry|rail|subway|tram)$/;

/** Basemap layers that draw POIs, by id. */
export const POI_LAYER_IDS = ['POI', 'POI - Micro'];

/** Sorted category ids from a sprite sheet's icon names. */
export function extractPoiCategories(iconNames: Iterable<string>): string[] {
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const n of iconNames) {
    if (n.startsWith(POI_PREFIX)) names.add(n.slice(POI_PREFIX.length));
  }
  const categories: string[] = [];
  for (const n of names) {
    if (VARIANT_SUFFIX.test(n)) continue;
    // A name with a "-micro" sibling is a group icon, not a category
    if (names.has(`${n}-micro`)) continue;
    categories.push(n);
  }
  return categories.sort();
}

/** "school_or_kindergarten" -> "School or kindergarten" */
export function poiCategoryLabel(category: string): string {
  const t = category.replace(/_/g, ' ');
  return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
}

/**
 * Restricts the style's POI layers to the given categories (an empty list
 * hides all POIs). Returns the style untouched when `categories` is null.
 */
export function applyPoiCategoryFilter(
  style: StyleSpecification,
  categories: string[] | null
): StyleSpecification {
  if (categories === null) return style;
  const clause: unknown =
    categories.length === 0
      ? false
      : ['match', ['get', 'category'], categories, true, false];
  return {
    ...style,
    layers: style.layers.map((l): LayerSpecification => {
      if (!POI_LAYER_IDS.includes(l.id) || l.type !== 'symbol') return l;
      const f = l.filter as unknown[] | undefined;
      const filter =
        Array.isArray(f) && f[0] === 'all'
          ? [...f, clause]
          : f
            ? ['all', f, clause]
            : ['all', clause];
      return { ...l, filter: filter as typeof l.filter };
    }),
  };
}
EOF
cat > src/hooks/usePoiCategories.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * POI category dictionary for the current basemap style, read from its
 * sprite sheet (cached per style by loadSpriteSheet).
 */
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { loadSpriteSheet } from '@/utils/spriteShields';
import { extractPoiCategories } from '@/utils/poiCategories';

export function usePoiCategories(): string[] {
  const style = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.mapStyle);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<string[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    loadSpriteSheet(style)
      .then((sheet) => {
        if (!cancelled) setCategories(extractPoiCategories(Object.keys(sheet.meta)));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setCategories([]);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [style]);
  return categories;
}
EOF

KEY=$(grep '^NEXT_PUBLIC_NEXTBILLION_API_KEY=' .env.local | cut -d= -f2 | awk '{print $1}'); SCR=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-[USER]-workspace-tomtom-playground/be5a46ff-85a2-48fc-9a66-ace04b4ac027/scratchpad
python3 - <<'EOF' > $SCR/tile_xy.txt
import math
lat,lng,z=40.7505,-73.9934,14
n=2**z; x=int((lng+180)/360*n); y=int((1-math.log(math.tan(math.radians(lat))+1/math.cos(math.radians(lat)))/math.pi)/2*n)
print(z,x,y)
EOF
read Z X Y < $SCR/tile_xy.txt; echo "tile $Z/$X/$Y"; curl -s "https://api.nextbillion.io/orbis/tile/$Z/$X/$Y.pbf?apiVersion=1&key=$KEY" -o $SCR/t14.pbf
node -e "
const fs=require('fs'); const {VectorTile}=require('@mapbox/vector-tile'); const Pbf=require('pbf');
const t=new VectorTile(new Pbf(fs.readFileSync('$SCR/t14.pbf'))); const L=t.layers.poi; console.log('poi features:', L ? L.length : 0);
const cats={}; for (let i=0;i<L.length;i++){ const p=L.feature(i).properties; cats[p.category]=(cats[p.category]||0)+1; if (/Madison Square|Salem|Gallery/.test(p.name||'')) console.log(JSON.stringify(p)); }
console.log('categories in tile:', JSON.stringify(cats));
"

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T17:49:41.541Z)

Done — committed as `77941b4`, working tree clean.

**What changed**
- Every Discover (place search) request now carries `lang=` derived from the Language setting, defaulting to `lang=en-US`. The proxy (`/api/geocoding/discover`) forwards it and `discoverPlaces()` sets it from `useT().discoverLang`; an open search re-queries if you change language mid-typing.
- The Discover API is picky about codes (I probed each): it accepts `en-US`, `en-GB`, `fr-CA`, `pt-BR`, `es-419`, `ar`, but returns 400 for `en-CA`, `es-MX`, `ar-SA`, and bare `fr`/`es`. So each UI locale maps to the closest accepted value in `src/i18n/locales.ts`:
  - en-US → `en-US`, en-CA → `en-US`, en-GB → `en-GB`, fr-CA → `fr-CA`, es-MX → `es-419` (Latin-American Spanish), pt-BR → `pt-BR`, ar-SA → `ar`.
- Verified on the dev server: a default search sent `lang=en-US`; after switching to Français (Canada) the next searches sent `lang=fr-CA`, and the API resolved the French query "musée" to museums.

Not deployed or pushed — `main` is one commit ahead of `origin/main`; say the word and I'll push and run the build → deploy pipeline (the gcloud session from earlier is still fresh).

/**
 * Persists the user's Settings (units, language, POI category filter) in
 * localStorage so they survive reloads. Values are validated on load so a
 * stale or hand-edited entry can't put the store in a bad state.
 */
import type { DistanceUnits } from '@/utils/formatting';
import { LOCALES, type Locale } from '@/i18n/locales';

export const SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY = 'nb-routing-playground.settings';

export interface PersistedSettings {
  units: DistanceUnits;
  language: Locale;
  /** null = all categories */
  poiCategories: string[] | null;
}

const UNITS: DistanceUnits[] = ['metric', 'imperial'];
const LOCALE_IDS = new Set<string>(LOCALES.map((l) => l.id));

/** Reads and validates saved settings; missing/invalid fields are omitted. */
export function loadSettings(): Partial<PersistedSettings> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const data = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const out: Partial<PersistedSettings> = {};
    if (UNITS.includes(data.units as DistanceUnits)) {
      out.units = data.units as DistanceUnits;
    }
    if (typeof data.language === 'string' && LOCALE_IDS.has(data.language)) {
      out.language = data.language as Locale;
    }
    if (data.poiCategories === null) {
      out.poiCategories = null;
    } else if (
      Array.isArray(data.poiCategories) &&
      data.poiCategories.every((c) => typeof c === 'string')
    ) {
      out.poiCategories = data.poiCategories as string[];
    }
    return out;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function saveSettings(settings: PersistedSettings): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
  } catch {
    // Storage may be full or disabled (private mode); settings stay in memory
  }
}
EOF
cat > src/components/providers/SettingsPersistence.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * Restores persisted Settings into the store on first render and writes
 * them back whenever they change. Renders nothing.
 */
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { loadSettings, saveSettings } from '@/store/persistSettings';

export function SettingsPersistence() {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const units = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.units);
  const language = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.language);
  const poiCategories = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.poiCategories);
  const restored = useRef(false);

  // Restore once, after mount (localStorage is client-only)
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = loadSettings();
    if (saved.units) dispatch.ui.setUnits(saved.units);
    if (saved.language) dispatch.ui.setLanguage(saved.language);
    if (saved.poiCategories !== undefined) {
      dispatch.ui.setPoiCategories(saved.poiCategories);
    }
    restored.current = true;
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Save on change — but not before the restore has run, or the defaults
  // would overwrite what was saved
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!restored.current) return;
    saveSettings({ units, language, poiCategories });
  }, [units, language, poiCategories]);

  return null;
}

export default SettingsPersistence;
EOF

    open(path,'w').write(s)

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T17:57:26.321Z)

Committed as `bc2288d`. Now to your question — I checked the actual data:

**What's available for the POI card, per language**

1. **POI name** — the vector tiles carry the default (local) `name`, and only a *sparse* set of alternates as `name_<lang>` properties. In the Midtown z14 tile, of 94 POIs: 6 had `name_zh-Hans/Hant`, 3 `name_ru`, 2 `name_ko`, 1 `name_fr`, 1 `name_pt`, 1 `name_ja`; the downtown z15 tile had a single `name_pt`. So translated names exist for a handful of well-known places (MSG has Chinese names, for example), but for the vast majority there's nothing but the local name — which is what you'd want anyway (a Montréal bakery's name is its name).

2. **Category** — the tiles only carry the English category *id* (`stadium`, `school_or_kindergarten`, …). The card currently humanizes that id, so "Stadium"/"School or kindergarten" stays English in every language. This isn't in the tiles at all; translating it means shipping our own catalog (~215 categories × 6 languages), the same way the incident categories are already translated in `src/i18n/messages/*`.

3. **Address** — this comes from the NB reverse geocoder, and it **does** honour `lang`: for a Montréal point, `lang=fr-CA` returns "1100 Boulevard Robert-Bourassa, Montréal QC…" (accented), while the default gives "Montreal". We don't pass it today.

**So**: no, the tile detail is essentially English/local-only apart from the occasional `name_<lang>`, but two of the three lines on the card can be localized cheaply — pass `lang` (same mapping as Discover) to the reverse-geocode call for the address, and prefer `name_<lang>` when the tile has it. The category line needs a translation catalog; I can write one (it's mechanical, and I already have the full category list from the sprite) if you want the card fully localized. Say which of those you'd like and I'll do it.

**Persistence recap** (the task you asked for): Units, Language and POI-category filter are saved to `localStorage` under `nb-routing-playground.settings`, validated on restore, saved on every change, and "Reset all" now preserves them. Verified: set Imperial + Français → reload → app came back in French with Imperial selected. `main` is two commits ahead of `origin/main`, not yet pushed or deployed.

import json,sys,math
def decode(s, prec=5):
    idx=0; lat=0; lng=0; out=[]
    while idx < len(s):
        for which in (0,1):
            shift=result=0
            while True:
                b=ord(s[idx])-63; idx+=1; result|=(b&0x1f)<<shift; shift+=5
                if b<0x20: break
            d=~(result>>1) if result&1 else result>>1
            if which==0: lat+=d
            else: lng+=d
        out.append((lat/10**prec, lng/10**prec))
    return out
def dist(a,b):
    R=6371000; p1,p2=math.radians(a[0]),math.radians(b[0]); dl=math.radians(b[1]-a[1]); dp=p2-p1
    h=math.sin(dp/2)**2+math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2; return 2*R*math.asin(math.sqrt(h))
pt=tuple(map(float,sys.argv[1].split(',')))
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
if d.get('status')!='Ok': print(d.get('status'),d.get('msg')); sys.exit()
r=d['routes'][0]; g=r['geometry']; coords=decode(g, 6) if any(abs(c[0])>90 for c in decode(g,5)[:3]) else decode(g,5)
m=min(dist(pt,c) for c in coords)
print(f"{r['distance']/1000:.1f} km {r['duration']/60:.0f} min | min distance to point: {m:.0f} m")
EOF

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T18:18:55.004Z)

Root cause found, and it's on the API side, not the app.

**What the app sends is correct.** Your route (17 mi / 41 min via I-495) is byte-for-byte what the Directions API returns for `mode=truck&option=flexible&hazmat_type=circumstantial` — so the parameter is being sent and accepted (an invalid value like `hazmat_type=bogus` is rejected with `InvalidValue`, which proves the API is reading it).

**The API just doesn't apply tunnel hazmat restrictions.** I tested EWR → Madison Square Garden and three other tunnels where hazmat is legally prohibited, comparing every `hazmat_type` value against no hazmat and against `avoid=tunnel`:

| Corridor (truck mode) | none | any `hazmat_type` (each of the 4, and all 4 combined) | `avoid=tunnel` |
|---|---|---|---|
| EWR → MSG, Lincoln Tunnel | 27.0 km / 41 min, through tunnel | **identical** | 50.4 km / 61 min, no tunnel |
| Baltimore, Fort McHenry Tunnel (I-95, all hazmat banned) | 27.9 km / 28 min, through tunnel | **identical** | 28.7 km / 46 min, no tunnel |
| London, Blackwall Tunnel (dangerous goods prohibited) | 5.6 km / 13 min, through tunnel | **identical** | 12.2 km / 34 min |
| Rotterdam, Beneluxtunnel (A4) | 13.0 km / 16 min, through tunnel | **identical** | 40.4 km / 43 min |

Not one hazmat class changed a single route in any region, US or Europe, while `avoid=tunnel`/`exclude=tunnel` always re-routed. So NB's flexible engine accepts `hazmat_type` but the tunnel-restriction attributes it would need to act on are either absent from the underlying map data or not wired into routing — "Circumstantial" (which in ADR terms means the tunnel-category restrictions) behaves as a no-op today. That's worth raising with the NB routing team; a one-line reproducer:

```
curl "https://api.nextbillion.io/directions/json?origin=40.6895,-74.1745&destination=40.7505,-73.9934&mode=truck&option=flexible&hazmat_type=circumstantial&key=$KEY"
```
(returns the Lincoln Tunnel route; the same call with `avoid=tunnel` instead does not).

**Practical options in the meantime**
1. Add **Tunnels** to *Exclude* (strict) or *Avoid* (soft) alongside the hazmat class — I confirmed `hazmat_type=circumstantial&avoid=tunnel` gives the 50 km tunnel-free route.
2. If you'd like, I can make the app do that automatically: when any hazmat class is selected, add "Tunnels" to Avoid (or Exclude) and show a small note that tunnel avoidance is being applied because hazmat restrictions aren't yet enforced by the API. Say which behaviour you prefer and I'll wire it up.

/**
 * Server-side API key selection for routing proxies.
 *
 * Hazardous-material restrictions are only enforced for a dedicated key
 * (NEXTBILLION_HAZMAT_API_KEY); when a request carries hazmat_type and
 * that key is configured, it is used instead of the default key.
 */
const DEFAULT_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const HAZMAT_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_HAZMAT_API_KEY || '';

function hasHazmat(value: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0;
}

/** Key for a request whose parameters are given as a query string or body. */
export function routingApiKey(
  params: URLSearchParams | Record<string, unknown>
): string {
  const hazmat =
    params instanceof URLSearchParams
      ? params.get('hazmat_type')
      : params.hazmat_type;
  return hasHazmat(hazmat) && HAZMAT_KEY ? HAZMAT_KEY : DEFAULT_KEY;
}

export function hasRoutingApiKey(): boolean {
  return DEFAULT_KEY.length > 0;
}

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T18:22:15.018Z)

Done — committed as `5ccad34`, working tree clean, secrets kept out of git.

**How the workaround works**
- New server-side helper `src/lib/routingApiKey.ts`: when a directions or navigation request carries a non-empty `hazmat_type`, the proxy signs it with `NEXTBILLION_HAZMAT_API_KEY`; everything else keeps using `NEXTBILLION_API_KEY`. Selection happens only in `/api/routing/directions` (GET and POST) and `/api/routing/navigation` — the key never reaches the browser. If the hazmat key isn't configured, behaviour falls back to the default key.
- The key is stored in the gitignored `.env.local` (dev) with a placeholder line added to `.env.example`. Terraform gains an optional `nextbillion_hazmat_api_key` variable → Secret Manager secret → `NEXTBILLION_HAZMAT_API_KEY` on Cloud Run (all created only when the variable is set); it's already in your local `terraform.tfvars`, and `terraform validate` passes.
- Verified through the dev proxy: EWR → MSG truck route is 27.0 km without hazmat and **50.0 km, 2 km clear of the Lincoln Tunnel** with `hazmat_type=circumstantial`. Navigation with the same params also returns the tunnel-free route.

**One caveat from testing the new key**: it enforces *Circumstantial* correctly, but `hazmat_type=explosive` still returned the Lincoln Tunnel route (27.2 km) on that key — so the tunnel is tagged with the circumstantial/tunnel-category restriction in that dataset but not with an explosives ban. Worth mentioning to NB alongside the earlier finding.

The live Cloud Run service doesn't have the new key yet — say the word and I'll run the usual build → push → `terraform apply` (which will also create the new secret) and push `main` (now five commits ahead).

cat > src/components/map/SearchResultMarkers.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * Pins for the suggestions of an open place search. Each result shows its
 * position pin plus, when the API reports a separate road-side access
 * point, a small access marker joined to the position by a dashed blue
 * arc. The suggestion under the cursor (or keyboard focus) in the list is
 * enlarged, coloured and labelled so it stands out from the others.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Layer, Marker, Source } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { LineLayer } from 'react-map-gl';
import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import type { PlaceSuggestion } from '@/services/geocoding/geocodingApi';

const ARC_SOURCE_ID = 'search-access-arcs';
const ARC_LAYER_ID = 'search-access-arcs';
const ARC_SEGMENTS = 24;
/** Sideways bulge of the arc as a fraction of the chord length. */
const ARC_BULGE = 0.25;
/** Access points closer than this to the position aren't worth drawing. */
const MIN_ACCESS_OFFSET_DEG = 1e-5;

/** Quadratic-bezier arc from a to b, bowing to one side of the chord. */
function arcCoordinates(a: [number, number], b: [number, number]): number[][] {
  const [ax, ay] = a;
  const [bx, by] = b;
  const mx = (ax + bx) / 2;
  const my = (ay + by) / 2;
  // Perpendicular offset, corrected for longitude foreshortening so the
  // bow looks circular on screen
  const kx = Math.cos((my * Math.PI) / 180);
  const dx = (bx - ax) * kx;
  const dy = by - ay;
  const cx = mx + (-dy * ARC_BULGE) / kx;
  const cy = my + dx * ARC_BULGE;
  const pts: number[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= ARC_SEGMENTS; i++) {
    const t = i / ARC_SEGMENTS;
    const u = 1 - t;
    pts.push([
      u * u * ax + 2 * u * t * cx + t * t * bx,
      u * u * ay + 2 * u * t * cy + t * t * by,
    ]);
  }
  return pts;
}

function hasSeparateAccess(r: PlaceSuggestion): r is PlaceSuggestion & { access: [number, number] } {
  return (
    !!r.access &&
    (Math.abs(r.access[0] - r.coordinates[0]) > MIN_ACCESS_OFFSET_DEG ||
      Math.abs(r.access[1] - r.coordinates[1]) > MIN_ACCESS_OFFSET_DEG)
  );
}

const arcLayerStyle: LineLayer = {
  id: ARC_LAYER_ID,
  type: 'line',
  source: ARC_SOURCE_ID,
  layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' },
  paint: {
    'line-color': '#1976D2',
    'line-width': ['case', ['boolean', ['get', 'active'], false], 2.5, 1.5],
    'line-opacity': ['case', ['boolean', ['get', 'active'], false], 1, 0.7],
    'line-dasharray': [2, 2],
  },
};

export const SearchResultMarkers: React.FC = () => {
  const results = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.searchResults);
  const highlightId = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.searchHighlightId);

  // Dashed arcs from each access point to its place position
  const arcs = useMemo(
    (): GeoJSON.FeatureCollection<GeoJSON.LineString> => ({
      type: 'FeatureCollection',
      features: results.filter(hasSeparateAccess).map((r) => ({
        type: 'Feature',
        properties: { id: r.id, active: r.id === highlightId },
        geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: arcCoordinates(r.access, r.coordinates) },
      })),
    }),
    [results, highlightId]
  );

  if (results.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <Source id={ARC_SOURCE_ID} type="geojson" data={arcs}>
        <Layer {...arcLayerStyle} />
      </Source>

      {results.map((r) => {
        const active = r.id === highlightId;
        return (
          <React.Fragment key={r.id}>
            {/* Road-side access point */}
            {hasSeparateAccess(r) && (
              <Marker
                longitude={r.access[0]}
                latitude={r.access[1]}
                anchor="center"
                style={{ zIndex: active ? 3 : 1, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
              >
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: active ? 10 : 7,
                    height: active ? 10 : 7,
                    transform: 'rotate(45deg)',
                    bgcolor: '#1976D2',
                    border: '1.5px solid #fff',
                    boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
                    opacity: active ? 1 : 0.8,
                    transition: 'width 120ms, height 120ms',
                  }}
                />
              </Marker>
            )}

            {/* Place position */}
            <Marker
              longitude={r.coordinates[0]}
              latitude={r.coordinates[1]}
              anchor="center"
              style={{ zIndex: active ? 3 : 2, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
            >
              <Box
                sx={{
                  position: 'relative',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    width: active ? 22 : 12,
                    height: active ? 22 : 12,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    bgcolor: active ? 'primary.main' : '#9e9e9e',
                    border: '2px solid #fff',
                    boxShadow: active
                      ? '0 0 0 4px rgba(25,118,210,0.25), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'
                      : '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
                    opacity: active ? 1 : 0.85,
                    transition: 'width 120ms, height 120ms, background-color 120ms',
                  }}
                />
                {active && (
                  <Typography
                    variant="caption"
                    sx={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      top: '100%',
                      mt: 0.5,
                      px: 0.75,
                      py: 0.25,
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      bgcolor: 'background.paper',
                      color: 'text.primary',
                      borderRadius: 1,
                      boxShadow: 2,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      lineHeight: 1.3,
                    }}
                  >
                    {r.title}
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </Box>
            </Marker>
          </React.Fragment>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

export default SearchResultMarkers;
EOF

echo "--- revgeocode lang"; for L in de-DE nl-NL sv-SE fi-FI nb-NO no-NO da-DK it-IT; do printf "%-6s " $L; curl -sg "https://api.nextbillion.io/revgeocode?at=48.8566,2.3522&lang=$L&key=$KEY" -w " HTTP %{http_code}" | python3 -c "
import sys,json; raw=sys.stdin.read(); body,code=raw.rsplit(' HTTP ',1)
try: d=json.loads(body); print(code.strip(), '|', (d.get('items') or [{}])[0].get('title','')[-30:])
except Exception: print(code.strip(), body[:80])"; done

python3 - <<'EOF'
def sub(path, pairs):
    s=open(path).read()
    for a,b in pairs:
        if a not in s: raise SystemExit(f'missing in {path}: {a[:80]!r}')
        s=s.replace(a,b)
    open(path,'w').write(s)

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T18:39:19.659Z)

Both requests are done and committed.

**Access points on search results (`cb06846`)**
- Discover results now keep the API's `access` point (the road-side entrance). For every result pin during a search, a small blue diamond marks the access point and a dashed blue arc (a quadratic bow, foreshortening-corrected so it looks round on screen) links it to the place position. The highlighted suggestion gets the larger blue pin, a bigger diamond and a bolder/opaque arc; the rest are drawn fainter. Results whose access point coincides with the position get no arc.
- Verified in a separate tab at z16 around Madison Square Garden: arcs and diamonds present for all six results, emphasis following the hovered list item.

**Seven new UI languages (`d7e6427`)** — Deutsch, Nederlands, Svenska, Suomi, Norsk (bokmål), Dansk, Italiano, each a full catalog (the `Messages` type enforces every key, and `tsc` passes). I probed the API codes per service, since they differ: Navigation only honours bare codes (`de`, `nl`, `sv`, `fi`, `no`, `da`, `it` — regional tags fall back to English), while Discover and reverse geocoding require regional tags (`de-DE`, `nl-NL`, `sv-SE`, `fi-FI`, `nb-NO`, `da-DK`, `it-IT`); those mappings are in `src/i18n/locales.ts`. Verified the German UI end-to-end in the browser.

/**
 * Date/time localisation for the departure picker: the dayjs locale (field
 * format, calendar, first day of week) and MUI X picker texts per UI locale.
 */
import 'dayjs/locale/en';
import 'dayjs/locale/en-ca';
import 'dayjs/locale/en-gb';
import 'dayjs/locale/fr-ca';
import 'dayjs/locale/es-mx';
import 'dayjs/locale/pt-br';
import 'dayjs/locale/ar-sa';
import 'dayjs/locale/de';
import 'dayjs/locale/nl';
import 'dayjs/locale/sv';
import 'dayjs/locale/fi';
import 'dayjs/locale/nb';
import 'dayjs/locale/da';
import 'dayjs/locale/it';
import {
  enUS,
  frFR,
  esES,
  ptBR,
  deDE,
  nlNL,
  svSE,
  fiFI,
  nbNO,
  daDK,
  itIT,
} from '@mui/x-date-pickers/locales';
import type { PickersLocaleText } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/locales';
import type { Locale } from './locales';

interface DateLocale {
  /** dayjs locale id (lower-case, as registered by dayjs). */
  dayjs: string;
  /** MUI X picker texts (buttons, toolbar, aria labels). */
  text: Partial<PickersLocaleText>;
}

const pick = (bundle: { components: { MuiLocalizationProvider: { defaultProps: { localeText: Partial<PickersLocaleText> } } } }) =>
  bundle.components.MuiLocalizationProvider.defaultProps.localeText;

// MUI X ships no Arabic bundle; translate the texts users actually see
const arText: Partial<PickersLocaleText> = {
  cancelButtonLabel: 'إلغاء',
  okButtonLabel: 'موافق',
  clearButtonLabel: 'مسح',
  todayButtonLabel: 'اليوم',
  previousMonth: 'الشهر السابق',
  nextMonth: 'الشهر التالي',
  datePickerToolbarTitle: 'اختر التاريخ',
  dateTimePickerToolbarTitle: 'اختر التاريخ والوقت',
  timePickerToolbarTitle: 'اختر الوقت',
  fieldYearPlaceholder: () => 'سسسس',
  fieldMonthPlaceholder: () => 'شش',
  fieldDayPlaceholder: () => 'يي',
  fieldHoursPlaceholder: () => 'سس',
  fieldMinutesPlaceholder: () => 'دد',
  fieldMeridiemPlaceholder: () => 'ص/م',
  empty: 'فارغ',
};

const DATE_LOCALES: Record<Locale, DateLocale> = {
  'en-US': { dayjs: 'en', text: pick(enUS) },
  'en-CA': { dayjs: 'en-ca', text: pick(enUS) },
  'en-GB': { dayjs: 'en-gb', text: pick(enUS) },
  'fr-CA': { dayjs: 'fr-ca', text: pick(frFR) },
  'es-MX': { dayjs: 'es-mx', text: pick(esES) },
  'pt-BR': { dayjs: 'pt-br', text: pick(ptBR) },
  'ar-SA': { dayjs: 'ar-sa', text: arText },
  'de-DE': { dayjs: 'de', text: pick(deDE) },
  'nl-NL': { dayjs: 'nl', text: pick(nlNL) },
  'sv-SE': { dayjs: 'sv', text: pick(svSE) },
  'fi-FI': { dayjs: 'fi', text: pick(fiFI) },
  'nb-NO': { dayjs: 'nb', text: pick(nbNO) },
  'da-DK': { dayjs: 'da', text: pick(daDK) },
  'it-IT': { dayjs: 'it', text: pick(itIT) },
};

export function getDateLocale(locale: Locale): DateLocale {
  return DATE_LOCALES[locale] ?? DATE_LOCALES['en-US'];
}
EOF
cat > src/components/sidebar/DepartureTimePicker.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * Departure date/time picker, localised to the UI language: field format,
 * calendar and button texts follow the selected locale rather than the
 * browser's.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import dayjs, { type Dayjs } from 'dayjs';
import { LocalizationProvider, DateTimePicker } from '@mui/x-date-pickers';
import { AdapterDayjs } from '@mui/x-date-pickers/AdapterDayjs';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/useT';
import { getDateLocale } from '@/i18n/dateLocale';

interface DepartureTimePickerProps {
  value: Date | null | undefined;
  onChange: (value: Date | null) => void;
}

export const DepartureTimePicker: React.FC<DepartureTimePickerProps> = ({ value, onChange }) => {
  const { locale } = useT();
  const { dayjs: dayjsLocale, text } = getDateLocale(locale);
  const picked = useMemo<Dayjs | null>(() => (value ? dayjs(value) : null), [value]);

  return (
    <LocalizationProvider
      dateAdapter={AdapterDayjs}
      adapterLocale={dayjsLocale}
      localeText={text}
    >
      <DateTimePicker
        value={picked}
        onChange={(d) => onChange(d && d.isValid() ? d.toDate() : null)}
        disablePast
        slotProps={{
          textField: { size: 'small', fullWidth: true, sx: { mt: 0.5 } },
          field: { clearable: true },
          actionBar: { actions: ['clear', 'today', 'accept'] },
        }}
      />
    </LocalizationProvider>
  );
};

export default DepartureTimePicker;
EOF

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T18:43:56.949Z)

Done — committed as `3d243cc`, working tree clean.

**What changed**
- The Departure control was a native `<input type="datetime-local">`, whose format and calendar follow the *browser's* locale and can't be driven by the app's Language setting. It's now a MUI X `DateTimePicker` (dayjs adapter) — `src/components/sidebar/DepartureTimePicker.tsx` — wrapped in its own `LocalizationProvider` bound to the selected locale.
- `src/i18n/dateLocale.ts` maps each of the 14 UI locales to a dayjs locale (field format, month/day names, first day of week, 12/24-hour clock) and MUI X's translated picker texts (Clear/Today/OK, toolbar titles, aria labels). MUI ships no Arabic bundle, so I added a small Arabic set for the visible labels; Arabic also uses the `ar-sa` dayjs locale.
- Behaviour is otherwise unchanged: the picker still yields a `Date` into `routingOptions.departureTime`, so `departure_time` on directions/navigation requests works as before; past times are disabled and the field is clearable.
- New dependencies: `@mui/x-date-pickers` 9.12 and `dayjs` 1.11.

**Verified** in a separate tab: in German the field shows `TT.MM.JJJJ hh:mm`, and the picker opens with a Monday-first calendar, "August 2026", a 24-hour clock and "Löschen / Heute / OK". Your storage was restored to English (US) afterwards.

`main` is now eleven commits ahead of `origin/main` — nothing pushed or deployed until you say so.

/**
 * API Route: Proxy to the NextBillion.ai Route Optimization v2 API (create
 * job). The body is forwarded as-is with the server-side key.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const NB_API_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const NB_OPT_URL = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/optimization/v2';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!NB_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'API key not configured' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const response = await fetch(`${NB_OPT_URL}?key=${NB_API_KEY}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Optimization API error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'Failed to create optimization job' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
EOF

/**
 * API Route: Proxy to the NextBillion.ai Route Optimization v2 result
 * endpoint (poll a job by id).
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const NB_API_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const NB_OPT_RESULT_URL = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/optimization/v2/result';

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!NB_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'API key not configured' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
  const id = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('id');
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'Missing "id" parameter' },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ id, key: NB_API_KEY });
    const response = await fetch(`${NB_OPT_RESULT_URL}?${params}`, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Optimization result API error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { status: 'Error', msg: 'Failed to fetch optimization result' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
EOF

/**
 * NextBillion.ai Route Optimization v2 client — single-vehicle TSP over the
 * intermediate stops: the vehicle starts at the origin, ends at the
 * destination, and every stop is a job to be sequenced.
 */
import type { TravelMode } from '@/types/routing';

const CREATE_ENDPOINT = '/api/optimization';
const RESULT_ENDPOINT = '/api/optimization/result';
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1500;
const POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000;

export interface StopToOptimize {
  id: string;
  /** [lng, lat] */
  coordinates: [number, number];
}

export interface OptimizeStopsRequest {
  origin: [number, number];
  destination: [number, number];
  stops: StopToOptimize[];
  mode: TravelMode;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export interface OptimizeStopsResult {
  /** Stop ids in optimized visit order (unassigned stops appended last). */
  orderedIds: string[];
  /** Ids the optimizer could not sequence, if any. */
  unassignedIds: string[];
  distanceM?: number;
  durationSec?: number;
}

interface CreateResponse {
  id?: string;
  status?: string;
  msg?: string;
  message?: string;
}

interface ResultResponse {
  status?: string;
  message?: string;
  msg?: string;
  result?: {
    routes?: Array<{
      steps?: Array<{ type: string; id?: number }>;
      distance?: number;
      duration?: number;
    }>;
    unassigned?: Array<{ id?: number }>;
    summary?: { distance?: number; duration?: number };
  };
}

const sleep = (ms: number, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
  new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const t = setTimeout(resolve, ms);
    signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
    });
  });

const latLng = (c: [number, number]) => `${c[1]},${c[0]}`;

/** The optimizer's routing profiles; other modes fall back to car. */
function optimizationMode(mode: TravelMode): 'car' | 'truck' {
  return mode === 'truck' ? 'truck' : 'car';
}

/**
 * Solves the visit order for `stops` and resolves with their ids in order.
 * Throws with a readable message on failure or timeout.
 */
export async function optimizeStops(req: OptimizeStopsRequest): Promise<OptimizeStopsResult> {
  const { origin, destination, stops, mode, signal } = req;
  // Job ids are 1-based positions in `stops`; locations: origin, destination, stops…
  const body = {
    locations: {
      id: 1,
      location: [latLng(origin), latLng(destination), ...stops.map((s) => latLng(s.coordinates))],
    },
    jobs: stops.map((_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, location_index: i + 2 })),
    vehicles: [{ id: 1, start_index: 0, end_index: 1 }],
    options: {
      routing: { mode: optimizationMode(mode) },
      objective: { travel_cost: 'duration' },
    },
  };

  const created = await fetch(CREATE_ENDPOINT, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal,
  });
  const createData: CreateResponse = await created.json();
  if (!created.ok || !createData.id) {
    throw new Error(createData.msg ?? createData.message ?? `Optimization request failed (${created.status})`);
  }

  const deadline = Date.now() + POLL_TIMEOUT_MS;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    await sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS, signal);
    const res = await fetch(`${RESULT_ENDPOINT}?id=${encodeURIComponent(createData.id)}`, { signal });
    const data: ResultResponse = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || (data.status && data.status !== 'Ok')) {
      throw new Error(data.msg ?? data.message ?? `Optimization failed (${res.status})`);
    }
    if (!data.result) continue; // still processing

    const route = data.result.routes?.[0];
    const orderedIds = (route?.steps ?? [])
      .filter((st) => st.type === 'job' && typeof st.id === 'number')
      .map((st) => stops[(st.id as number) - 1]?.id)
      .filter((id): id is string => !!id);
    const unassignedIds = (data.result.unassigned ?? [])
      .map((u) => (typeof u.id === 'number' ? stops[u.id - 1]?.id : undefined))
      .filter((id): id is string => !!id);
    // Anything the solver dropped keeps its place at the end
    const seen = new Set(orderedIds);
    for (const s of stops) if (!seen.has(s.id)) orderedIds.push(s.id);
    return {
      orderedIds,
      unassignedIds,
      distanceM: route?.distance ?? data.result.summary?.distance,
      durationSec: route?.duration ?? data.result.summary?.duration,
    };
  }
  throw new Error('Optimization timed out');
}
EOF
cat > src/hooks/useStopOptimization.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Sequences intermediate stops with the Route Optimization service
 * (single vehicle: origin -> stops -> destination) whenever there are two or
 * more stops and optimization is enabled. Re-solves when the set of stops,
 * the endpoints or the travel mode change — not when only the order does,
 * so applying a solution doesn't trigger another solve.
 */
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { optimizeStops } from '@/services/routing/optimizationApi';
import type { Waypoint } from '@/types/routing';

const DEBOUNCE_MS = 600;
const isSet = (wp: Waypoint | null): wp is Waypoint =>
  !!wp && (wp.coordinates[0] !== 0 || wp.coordinates[1] !== 0);

export function useStopOptimization() {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const origin = useAppSelector((state) => state.waypoints.origin);
  const destination = useAppSelector((state) => state.waypoints.destination);
  const intermediates = useAppSelector((state) => state.waypoints.intermediates);
  const mode = useAppSelector((state) => state.routingOptions.mode);
  const enabled = useAppSelector((state) => state.routingOptions.optimizeStops);

  const lastSolvedKey = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const stops = intermediates.filter(isSet);
  // Order-independent identity of the problem
  const problemKey =
    enabled && isSet(origin) && isSet(destination) && stops.length >= 2
      ? [
          mode,
          origin.coordinates.join(','),
          destination.coordinates.join(','),
          stops
            .map((s) => `${s.id}@${s.coordinates.join(',')}`)
            .sort()
            .join('|'),
        ].join('#')
      : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!problemKey) {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      lastSolvedKey.current = null;
      dispatch.ui.setStopOptimization({ status: 'idle', error: null });
      return;
    }
    if (problemKey === lastSolvedKey.current) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;
      dispatch.ui.setStopOptimization({ status: 'running', error: null });
      try {
        const result = await optimizeStops({
          origin: origin!.coordinates,
          destination: destination!.coordinates,
          stops: stops.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, coordinates: s.coordinates })),
          mode,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        lastSolvedKey.current = problemKey;
        dispatch.waypoints.setIntermediateOrder(result.orderedIds);
        dispatch.ui.setStopOptimization({ status: 'done', error: null });
      } catch (err) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        dispatch.ui.setStopOptimization({
          status: 'error',
          error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Optimization failed',
        });
      }
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // origin/destination/stops are captured by problemKey
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [problemKey, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => () => abortRef.current?.abort(), []);
}

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T19:07:11.520Z)

Done — committed as `2872dff`, working tree clean.

**TSP stop sequencing (Route Optimization v2)**
- When there are **2+ intermediate stops** (and the toggle is on — default), the app submits a single-vehicle problem to `POST /optimization/v2`: vehicle `start_index` = origin, `end_index` = destination, every stop a job; objective `travel_cost: duration`; routing mode `truck` for truck, otherwise `car` (the optimizer only offers those two). It polls `/optimization/v2/result` (1.5 s, 45 s cap) through new server-side proxies (`/api/optimization`, `/api/optimization/result`) so the key stays private.
- The solved job order is applied with a new `waypoints.setIntermediateOrder` reducer, which changes the waypoint sequence and therefore triggers the normal directions (and navigation) recalculation. Stops the solver can't place are kept at the end.
- Re-solves happen only when the *set* of stops, an endpoint, or the mode changes (debounced 600 ms) — not when order changes — so applying a solution never loops, and manual drag-reordering isn't fought until the problem itself changes.
- Waypoints panel shows a **"Optimize stop order"** switch (with tooltip) once there are 2+ stops, plus a spinner / ✓ / ! status. Persisted in `routingOptions.optimizeStops`. Strings added in all 14 locales.

**Verified without the browser** (per your earlier interrupt): the direct API and the client through the dev proxies now agree — EWR → {ESB, Times Sq, City Hall} → MSG solves to City Hall → Times Sq → ESB (35.5 km, 75 min). One real bug was caught on the way: the first proxy hit (route compiling) returned a `result` shell without `routes`, which the client mistook for "done" and fell back to the original order; it now treats any result without a `routes` array as still processing.

Not verified visually in the UI yet. `main` is 14 commits ahead of `origin/main` — nothing pushed or deployed until you ask.

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T19:32:26.491Z)

Both done — committed as `7092379`, working tree clean, test tab closed.

**Marker drag adding a stray waypoint — fixed**
- Cause: waypoint markers are DOM elements inside maplibre's canvas container, so the mouseup that ends a drag (and even a plain press on a pin) bubbled up as a map `click`, which the map handler turned into a new waypoint right next to the one you were moving.
- Fix: any marker interaction (press, drag start/move/end, click on the pin) stamps a short 400 ms "ignore map clicks" window in `MapContainer`; the click handler bails inside it. Genuine map clicks elsewhere are unaffected.
- Verified in a fresh tab: dragging A from Long Island City to Greenpoint moved it and re-routed with the sidebar still showing only Origin and Destination; a press-release on B without moving also added nothing.

**Sidebar order** — Route Summary now sits directly under Waypoints, above Routing Options (Directions stays below the options).

`main` is one commit ahead of `origin/main` — not pushed or deployed until you ask.

}

const PALETTE = ['#e91e63', '#8e24aa', '#00897b', '#f4511e', '#3949ab', '#7cb342', '#fb8c00', '#00acc1'];

export function contentLayerColor(index: number): string {
  return PALETTE[index % PALETTE.length];
}

function ext(name: string): string {
  const i = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  return i >= 0 ? name.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
}
const base = (name: string) => name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');

/** Wraps any GeoJSON value (collection, feature, geometry) in a FeatureCollection. */
function toFeatureCollection(value: unknown): GeoJSON.FeatureCollection {
  const v = value as { type?: string } | null;
  if (!v || typeof v !== 'object' || !v.type) throw new Error('Not a GeoJSON object');
  if (v.type === 'FeatureCollection') return v as GeoJSON.FeatureCollection;
  if (v.type === 'Feature') return { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [v as GeoJSON.Feature] };
  return {
    type: 'FeatureCollection',
    features: [{ type: 'Feature', properties: {}, geometry: v as GeoJSON.Geometry }],
  };
}

function extendBounds(b: number[] | null, [x, y]: number[]): number[] {
  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) return b ?? [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
  if (!b) return [x, y, x, y];
  return [Math.min(b[0], x), Math.min(b[1], y), Math.max(b[2], x), Math.max(b[3], y)];
}

function walkCoords(coords: unknown, b: number[] | null): number[] | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(coords)) return b;
  if (typeof coords[0] === 'number') return extendBounds(b, coords as number[]);
  let out = b;
  for (const c of coords) out = walkCoords(c, out);
  return out;
}

export function featureCollectionBounds(
  fc: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection
): [number, number, number, number] | null {
  let b: number[] | null = null;
  const visit = (g: GeoJSON.Geometry | null) => {
    if (!g) return;
    if (g.type === 'GeometryCollection') g.geometries.forEach(visit);
    else b = walkCoords(g.coordinates, b);
  };
  for (const f of fc.features) visit(f.geometry);
  return b && b.every(Number.isFinite) ? (b as [number, number, number, number]) : null;
}

export interface ImportedLayer {
  name: string;
  data: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection;
}

/**
 * Turns a set of chosen files into layers. Files are grouped by basename so
 * a loose shapefile (foo.shp + foo.dbf + foo.prj) becomes one layer.
 * Rejects with the offending file name in the message.
 */
export async function importContentFiles(files: File[]): Promise<ImportedLayer[]> {
  const layers: ImportedLayer[] = [];
  const shapefileParts = new Map<string, Partial<Record<'shp' | 'dbf' | 'prj' | 'cpg', File>>>();

  for (const file of files) {
    const e = ext(file.name);
    if (e === 'shp' || e === 'dbf' || e === 'prj' || e === 'cpg') {
      const parts = shapefileParts.get(base(file.name)) ?? {};
      parts[e] = file;
      shapefileParts.set(base(file.name), parts);
    }
  }

  for (const file of files) {
    const e = ext(file.name);
    try {
      if (e === 'geojson' || e === 'json') {
        const text = await file.text();
        layers.push({ name: base(file.name), data: toFeatureCollection(JSON.parse(text)) });
      } else if (e === 'zip') {
        const shp = (await import('shpjs')).default;
        const parsed = await shp.parseZip(await file.arrayBuffer());
        for (const fc of Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed]) {
          layers.push({ name: fc.fileName ?? base(file.name), data: fc });
        }
      } else if (e === 'shp') {
        const shp = (await import('shpjs')).default;
        const parts = shapefileParts.get(base(file.name)) ?? {};
        const prj = parts.prj ? await parts.prj.text() : undefined;
        const geometries = shp.parseShp(await file.arrayBuffer(), prj);
        const properties = parts.dbf
          ? shp.parseDbf(
              await parts.dbf.arrayBuffer(),
              (parts.cpg ? await parts.cpg.arrayBuffer() : undefined) as unknown as ArrayBuffer
            )
          : geometries.map(() => ({}));
        layers.push({ name: base(file.name), data: shp.combine([geometries, properties]) });
      }
      // .dbf/.prj/.cpg are consumed with their .shp
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`${file.name}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unreadable file'}`);
    }
  }
  if (layers.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('No GeoJSON or Shapefile found in the selected files');
  }
  return layers;
}

/**
 * Renders user-uploaded content layers (GeoJSON / Shapefile imports):
 * polygons as translucent fills with outlines, lines as strokes, points
 * as circles, each in the layer's colour.
 */
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Layer, Source } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { FillLayer, LineLayer, CircleLayer } from 'react-map-gl';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';

interface ContentLayersProps {
  /** Insert below this style layer (e.g. the first label layer). */
  beforeId?: string;
}

export const ContentLayers: React.FC<ContentLayersProps> = ({ beforeId }) => {
  const layers = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.contentLayers);

  return (
    <>
      {layers
        .filter((l) => l.visible)
        .map((l) => {
          const sourceId = `content-${l.id}`;
          const fill: FillLayer = {
            id: `${sourceId}-fill`,
            type: 'fill',
            source: sourceId,
            filter: ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'Polygon'],
            paint: { 'fill-color': l.color, 'fill-opacity': 0.25 },
          };
          const outline: LineLayer = {
            id: `${sourceId}-outline`,
            type: 'line',
            source: sourceId,
            filter: ['any', ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'Polygon'], ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'LineString']],
            layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' },
            paint: { 'line-color': l.color, 'line-width': 2.5, 'line-opacity': 0.9 },
          };
          const points: CircleLayer = {
            id: `${sourceId}-points`,
            type: 'circle',
            source: sourceId,
            filter: ['==', ['geometry-type'], 'Point'],
            paint: {
              'circle-radius': 5,
              'circle-color': l.color,
              'circle-stroke-color': '#fff',
              'circle-stroke-width': 1.5,
            },
          };
          return (
            <Source key={l.id} id={sourceId} type="geojson" data={l.data}>
              <Layer {...fill} beforeId={beforeId} />
              <Layer {...outline} beforeId={beforeId} />
              <Layer {...points} beforeId={beforeId} />
            </Source>
          );
        })}
    </>
  );
};

export default ContentLayers;

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T19:48:40.923Z)

Short answer: yes — the attributes come through intact on import, so a property info window is straightforward, and a per-layer "fields to show" / "title field" picker in Settings is a natural place to configure it. Nothing of that exists yet; here's what you'd be choosing between.

**What the data gives us**
`shpjs` merges the `.dbf` attributes onto every feature as GeoJSON `properties` (GeoJSON files bring their own). Your transit-zone layer, for example, has one feature with `GTZ_QS: "Greater Transit Zone"`, `Shape_Leng`, `Shape_Area`. Field names and types are only known after parsing, which is why the picker has to appear per layer *after* import — exactly as you suggest.

**Options for the info window**

1. **Hover/click card on features** (my recommendation) — the same pattern as the POI and incident cards: `queryRenderedFeatures` on the layer's fill/line/circle layers under the cursor, then a Popup styled like the existing cards, coloured with the layer's swatch. Shows the layer name, a title line, and a property table. Hover to peek, click to pin.
2. **Show all properties** vs **selected fields** — default to all non-empty properties (works with zero configuration), with Settings letting you narrow the list.
3. **Title field** — pick one field (e.g. `GTZ_QS`) to use as the card heading; default to the first string-valued field, falling back to the layer name.
4. **Value formatting** — numbers through the locale formatter (e.g. `Shape_Area` → "4,390,086,774.18"), booleans/nulls tidied, long text clamped. Could also honour the Units setting for fields that look like lengths/areas, but that's guesswork on field names, so I'd leave it off unless you want it.
5. **Labels on the map** (optional extra) — a symbol layer drawing the title field beside each feature, toggleable per layer. Useful for zone layers like yours.

**Settings UI after import** — under each layer row in "Content layers": a *Title field* dropdown and a *Popup fields* multi-select, both populated from the union of property keys across the layer's features (with the detected type shown), plus a per-layer "Show info window" switch. Choices kept in the store alongside the layer (and, if you later want layers persisted, they'd persist with them).

**Effort**: option 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 together is a contained change (one map component, a store field per layer, the two pickers in Settings, and strings for 14 locales). Say the word and I'll build it — and tell me if you'd like the map labels (5) too.

def sub(path, pairs):
    s=open(path).read()
    for a,b in pairs:
        if a not in s: raise SystemExit(f'missing in {path}: {a[:80]!r}')

# ---- layer model + helpers
sub('src/utils/contentLayers.ts', [
("""  data: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection;
  /** [west, south, east, north] */
  bounds: [number, number, number, number] | null;
}
""","""  data: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection;
  /** [west, south, east, north] */
  bounds: [number, number, number, number] | null;
  /** Property keys present on the layer's features, in first-seen order. */
  fields: string[];
  /** Show an info window when hovering/clicking a feature. */
  popupEnabled: boolean;
  /** Property used as the info window title (null = layer name). */
  titleField: string | null;
  /** Properties listed in the info window (null = all). */
  popupFields: string[] | null;
}

/** Ordered union of property keys across the collection. */
export function collectFields(fc: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of fc.features) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(f.properties ?? {})) seen.add(k);
  }
  return [...seen];
}

/** First field whose values are (mostly) non-empty strings — a natural title. */
export function defaultTitleField(fc: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection, fields: string[]): string | null {
  const sample = fc.features.slice(0, 50);
  for (const k of fields) {
    const strings = sample.filter((f) => {
      const v = f.properties?.[k];
      return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0;
    }).length;
    if (strings > 0 && strings >= sample.length / 2) return k;
  }
  return null;
}
"""),

                      <TuneIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </Tooltip>
                  <Tooltip title={t('settings.removeLayer')}>
                    <IconButton
                      size="small"
                      aria-label={t('settings.removeLayer')}
                      onClick={() => dispatch.ui.removeContentLayer(layer.id)}
                    >
                      <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </IconButton>
                  </Tooltip>
                </Box>

                {/* Info window settings for this layer */}
                <Collapse in={expandedLayer === layer.id} unmountOnExit>
                  <Box
                    sx={{
                      ml: 1,
                      mt: 0.5,
                      mb: 1,
                      pl: 1.5,

                        />

                      sx={{ ml: 0 }}

                            {t('layer.titleField')}
                          </Typography>
                          <Select<string>

                                patch: { titleField: e.target.value || null },

                          >

                          <Autocomplete<string, true, false, false>
                            multiple
                            size="small"
                            disableCloseOnSelect
                            disablePortal
                            disabled={!layer.popupEnabled}
                            options={layer.fields}
                            value={layer.popupFields ?? []}
                            onChange={(_, value) =>
                              dispatch.ui.updateContentLayer({
                                id: layer.id,
                                patch: { popupFields: value.length ? value : null },
                              })

                            limitTags={2}
                            getLimitTagsText={(more) => `+${more}`}
                            renderOption={(props, option, { selected }) => {
                              const { key, ...rest } = props as typeof props & { key: string };
                              return (
                                <li key={key} {...rest}>
                                  <Checkbox size="small" checked={selected} sx={{ mr: 0.5, p: 0.25 }} />
                                  <Typography variant="body2">{option}</Typography>
                                </li>
                              );
                            }}
                            renderInput={(params) => (
                              <TextField {...params} placeholder={t('layer.allFields')} />
                            )}
                            ListboxProps={{ style: { maxHeight: 200 } }}
                          />
                        </Box>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </Box>
                </Collapse>
              </Box>
            ))}"""),

cat > src/components/map/ContentLayerCard.tsx <<'EOF'
/**
 * Info window for user-uploaded content layers: hovering a feature shows
 * a card with the layer's chosen title field and property values; clicking
 * pins it.
 */
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Popup, useMap } from 'react-map-gl';
import type { Map as MaplibreMap, MapMouseEvent } from 'maplibre-gl';
import { Box, GlobalStyles, IconButton, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { Close as CloseIcon } from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/useT';
import type { ContentLayer } from '@/utils/contentLayers';

const PICK_PX = 5;
const HIDE_DELAY_MS = 250;
const MAX_VALUE_CHARS = 160;

interface HoveredFeature {
  layer: ContentLayer;
  properties: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Card anchor: the point itself, or the cursor for lines/polygons. */
  lngLat: [number, number];
  key: string;
}

interface ContentLayerCardProps {
  suppressClickRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
}

function formatValue(v: unknown, locale: string): string {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '—';
  if (typeof v === 'number') return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 3 }).format(v);
  if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v ? '✓' : '✗';
  const s = typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v);
  return s.length > MAX_VALUE_CHARS ? `${s.slice(0, MAX_VALUE_CHARS)}…` : s;
}

export const ContentLayerCard: React.FC<ContentLayerCardProps> = ({ suppressClickRef }) => {
  const { current: mapRef } = useMap();
  const layers = useAppSelector((state) => state.ui.contentLayers);
  const { t, locale } = useT();
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<HoveredFeature | null>(null);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);

  const latest = useRef({ layers, hovered, pinned, suppressClickRef });
  latest.current = { layers, hovered, pinned, suppressClickRef };
  const hideTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const cancelHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
      hideTimer.current = null;
    }
  };
  const scheduleHide = () => {
    if (hideTimer.current || latest.current.pinned) return;
    hideTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      hideTimer.current = null;
      if (!latest.current.pinned) setHovered(null);
    }, HIDE_DELAY_MS);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef?.getMap() as unknown as MaplibreMap | undefined;
    if (!map) return;
    const canvas = map.getCanvas();
    let savedCursor: string | null = null;
    let pendingPin: HoveredFeature | null = null;

    const setCursor = (c: string) => {
      if (savedCursor === null) savedCursor = canvas.style.cursor;
      canvas.style.cursor = c;
    };
    const resetCursor = () => {
      if (savedCursor !== null) {
        canvas.style.cursor = savedCursor;
        savedCursor = null;
      }
    };

    const featureAt = (e: MapMouseEvent): HoveredFeature | null => {
      const active = latest.current.layers.filter((l) => l.visible && l.popupEnabled);
      if (!active.length) return null;
      const layerIds = active
        .flatMap((l) => [`content-${l.id}-points`, `content-${l.id}-outline`, `content-${l.id}-fill`])
        .filter((id) => map.getLayer(id));
      if (!layerIds.length) return null;
      const feats = map.queryRenderedFeatures(
        [
          [e.point.x - PICK_PX, e.point.y - PICK_PX],
          [e.point.x + PICK_PX, e.point.y + PICK_PX],
        ],
        { layers: layerIds }
      );
      const f = feats[0];
      if (!f) return null;
      const layerId = f.layer.id.replace(/^content-/, '').replace(/-(points|outline|fill)$/, '');
      const layer = active.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
      if (!layer) return null;
      const lngLat: [number, number] =
        f.geometry.type === 'Point'
          ? [f.geometry.coordinates[0], f.geometry.coordinates[1]]
          : [e.lngLat.lng, e.lngLat.lat];
      const properties = (f.properties ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
      return { layer, properties, lngLat, key: `${layer.id}:${f.id ?? JSON.stringify(properties)}` };
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      const hit = featureAt(e);
      if (hit) {
        setCursor('pointer');
        cancelHide();
        if (!latest.current.pinned && latest.current.hovered?.key !== hit.key) setHovered(hit);
        return;
      }
      resetCursor();
      if (!latest.current.pinned) scheduleHide();
    };
    const onMouseDown = (e: MapMouseEvent) => {
      if (e.originalEvent.button !== 0) return;
      pendingPin = featureAt(e);
      if (pendingPin) latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = true;
    };
    const onDragStart = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        pendingPin = null;
        latest.current.suppressClickRef.current = false;
      }
    };
    const onClick = () => {
      if (pendingPin) {
        cancelHide();
        setHovered(pendingPin);
        setPinned(true);
        pendingPin = null;
      } else if (latest.current.pinned) {
        setPinned(false);
        setHovered(null);
      }
    };
    const onMouseOut = () => {
      resetCursor();
      scheduleHide();
    };

    map.on('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    map.on('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    map.on('dragstart', onDragStart);
    map.on('click', onClick);
    map.on('mouseout', onMouseOut);
    return () => {
      map.off('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      map.off('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      map.off('dragstart', onDragStart);
      map.off('click', onClick);
      map.off('mouseout', onMouseOut);
      cancelHide();
      resetCursor();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [mapRef]);

  // Drop the card if its layer is removed, hidden or has popups disabled
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hovered) return;
    const live = layers.find((l) => l.id === hovered.layer.id);
    if (!live || !live.visible || !live.popupEnabled) {
      setHovered(null);
      setPinned(false);
    }
  }, [layers, hovered]);

  if (!hovered) return null;

  // Use the layer's current settings (they may change while the card is open)
  const layer = layers.find((l) => l.id === hovered.layer.id) ?? hovered.layer;
  const titleValue = layer.titleField ? hovered.properties[layer.titleField] : undefined;
  const title =
    titleValue !== undefined && titleValue !== null && titleValue !== ''
      ? formatValue(titleValue, locale)
      : layer.name;
  const fields = (layer.popupFields ?? layer.fields).filter((f) => f !== layer.titleField);
  const close = () => {
    setPinned(false);
    setHovered(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <GlobalStyles
        styles={{
          '.content-popup .maplibregl-popup-content': {
            padding: 0,
            borderRadius: 12,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)',
          },
          '.content-popup .maplibregl-popup-tip': { borderTopColor: '#fff' },
        }}
      />
      <Popup
        longitude={hovered.lngLat[0]}
        latitude={hovered.lngLat[1]}
        anchor="bottom"
        offset={12}
        closeButton={false}
        closeOnClick={false}
        maxWidth="340px"
        className="content-popup"
      >
        <Box onMouseEnter={cancelHide} onMouseLeave={scheduleHide} sx={{ width: 300 }}>
          {/* Header in the layer colour */}
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: 'relative',
              px: 2,
              py: 1.25,
              pr: pinned ? 5 : 2,
              bgcolor: layer.color,
              color: '#fff',
            }}
          >
            <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ opacity: 0.85, display: 'block' }} noWrap>
              {layer.name}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="subtitle1" fontWeight={700} lineHeight={1.25} noWrap title={title}>
              {title}
            </Typography>
            {pinned && (
              <IconButton
                size="small"
                aria-label={t('common.close')}
                onClick={close}
                sx={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: 6,
                  right: 6,
                  color: '#fff',
                  bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                  '&:hover': { bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' },
                }}
              >
                <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          </Box>

          {/* Property table */}
          <Box sx={{ px: 2, py: 1.25, maxHeight: 260, overflow: 'auto' }}>
            {fields.length === 0 ? (
              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.disabled">
                {t('layer.noProperties')}
              </Typography>
            ) : (
              <Box
                component="dl"
                sx={{
                  m: 0,
                  display: 'grid',
                  gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(80px, 40%) 1fr',
                  columnGap: 1.5,
                  rowGap: 0.5,
                }}
              >
                {fields.map((f) => (
                  <React.Fragment key={f}>
                    <Typography component="dt" variant="caption" color="text.secondary" noWrap title={f}>
                      {f}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography component="dd" variant="body2" sx={{ m: 0, wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>
                      {formatValue(hovered.properties[f], locale)}
                    </Typography>
                  </React.Fragment>
                ))}
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Popup>
    </>
  );
};

export default ContentLayerCard;

export interface DefaultContentLayer {
  /** Public URL of a GeoJSON file or zipped Shapefile. */
  url: string;
  /** Display name (defaults to the file's own name). */
  name?: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_CONTENT_LAYERS: DefaultContentLayer[] = [
