mkdir -p src/config && mv src/config/defaultLayers.ts src/config/defaultLayers.ts 2>/dev/null; cat > src/hooks/useDefaultContentLayers.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * Loads the bundled content layers (see config/defaultLayers) into the
 * store once on startup.
 */
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAppDispatch } from '@/store/hooks';
import { DEFAULT_CONTENT_LAYERS } from '@/config/defaultLayers';
import {
  collectFields,
  contentLayerColor,
  defaultTitleField,
  featureCollectionBounds,
  importContentFiles,
  type ContentLayer,
} from '@/utils/contentLayers';
import { generateId } from '@/utils/formatting';

// Load once per page, even with React StrictMode's double effects
let started = false;

export function useDefaultContentLayers() {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (started || DEFAULT_CONTENT_LAYERS.length === 0) return;
    started = true;

    (async () => {
      const layers: ContentLayer[] = [];
      for (const [i, def] of DEFAULT_CONTENT_LAYERS.entries()) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(def.url);
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
          const fileName = decodeURIComponent(def.url.split('/').pop() ?? 'layer');
          const file = new File([await res.blob()], fileName);
          const imported = await importContentFiles([file]);
          for (const l of imported) {
            const fields = collectFields(l.data);
            layers.push({
              id: generateId(),
              name: def.name ?? l.name,
              color: contentLayerColor(i),
              visible: true,
              featureCount: l.data.features.length,
              data: l.data,
              bounds: featureCollectionBounds(l.data),
              fields,
              popupEnabled: true,
              titleField: defaultTitleField(l.data, fields),
              popupFields: null,
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn(`Default content layer ${def.url} not loaded:`, err);
        }
      }
      if (layers.length) dispatch.ui.addContentLayers(layers);
    })();
  }, [dispatch]);
}
EOF

""","""  // Sequence 2+ stops with the Route Optimization service

/**
 * API Route: Proxy to the NextBillion.ai Geofence API (create).
 * Body is forwarded as-is with the server-side key.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const NB_API_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const NB_GEOFENCE_URL = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/geofence';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!NB_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'Error', msg: 'API key not configured' }, { status: 500 });
  }
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const response = await fetch(`${NB_GEOFENCE_URL}?key=${NB_API_KEY}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Geofence API error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'Error', msg: 'Failed to create geofence' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
EOF

/**
 * API Route: Proxy to the NextBillion.ai Geofence API (delete by id).
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const NB_API_KEY = process.env.NEXTBILLION_API_KEY || '';
const NB_GEOFENCE_URL = 'https://api.nextbillion.io/geofence';

export async function DELETE(
  _request: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  if (!NB_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'Error', msg: 'API key not configured' }, { status: 500 });
  }
  const { id } = await context.params;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      `${NB_GEOFENCE_URL}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}?key=${NB_API_KEY}`,
      { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } }
    );
    const data = await response.json();
    return NextResponse.json(data, {
      status: response.status,
      headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Geofence delete API error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'Error', msg: 'Failed to delete geofence' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
EOF
cat > src/services/routing/geofenceApi.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * NextBillion.ai Geofence API client (polygon geofences), used to turn an
 * uploaded layer into routing avoid areas (avoid=geofence_id:<id>).
 */

/** Maximum polygons we'll turn into geofences for one layer. */
export const MAX_GEOFENCES_PER_LAYER = 10;

/** Prefix of a geofence entry in the Directions API's avoid list. */
export const GEOFENCE_AVOID_PREFIX = 'geofence_id:';

export function geofenceAvoidValue(id: string): string {
  return `${GEOFENCE_AVOID_PREFIX}${id}`;
}

export function isGeofenceAvoid(value: string): boolean {
  return value.startsWith(GEOFENCE_AVOID_PREFIX);
}

/** Every simple polygon ring-set in a collection (MultiPolygons are split). */
export function extractPolygons(fc: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection): GeoJSON.Polygon[] {
  const out: GeoJSON.Polygon[] = [];
  const visit = (g: GeoJSON.Geometry | null) => {
    if (!g) return;
    if (g.type === 'Polygon') out.push(g);
    else if (g.type === 'MultiPolygon') {
      for (const coords of g.coordinates) out.push({ type: 'Polygon', coordinates: coords });
    } else if (g.type === 'GeometryCollection') g.geometries.forEach(visit);
  };
  for (const f of fc.features) visit(f.geometry);
  return out;
}

interface CreateResponse {
  status?: string;
  msg?: string;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

/** Creates one polygon geofence and resolves with its id. */
export async function createPolygonGeofence(
  name: string,
  polygon: GeoJSON.Polygon
): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch('/api/geofence', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'polygon', name, polygon: { geojson: polygon } }),
  });
  const data: CreateResponse = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok || !data.data?.id) {
    throw new Error(data.msg ?? `Geofence request failed (${res.status})`);
  }
  return data.data.id;
}

/** Deletes a geofence; failures are swallowed (the fence may already be gone). */
export async function deleteGeofence(id: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await fetch(`/api/geofence/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
  } catch {
    // best effort
  }
}

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T20:21:22.881Z)

Done — committed as `23b63c2`, working tree clean, test tab closed, and the geofence I created while testing was deleted from your NB account.

**Geofence from a content layer** (Settings → layer's slider icon → *Geofence*)
- **"Create geofence and avoid it in routing"** takes the layer's polygon features (MultiPolygons are split; enabled for 1–10 polygons, otherwise the button is disabled with a hint), creates each as a NextBillion polygon geofence through a new server-side proxy (`POST /api/geofence`, key never leaves the server), and adds every id to the routing **Avoid** list as `geofence_id:<id>`. The Avoid multi-select shows them as "Geofence: <layer name>" chips (numbered when a layer yields several), so they can be unticked or re-ticked like any other avoid.
- The status flips to "Avoided in routing (n geofence)" with a **Remove geofence** action, which deletes the fences (`DELETE /api/geofence/:id`) and drops the avoids; removing the layer does the same. If creation fails partway, the fences already created are rolled back.
- Verified against the API first: `avoid=geofence_id:…` works on both Directions and Navigation (a fence you start inside yields `NoRoute`, as expected), and in the app: uploaded a Midtown polygon → created its geofence → "Geofence: midtown-zone" appeared in Avoid → a Cooper Square → W 70th route detoured east around the zone, with the request carrying `avoid=geofence_id:f3557fb2-…`.
- Works for any content layer with polygons (uploaded or bundled), not only GeoJSON. Note geofences live server-side: a page reload forgets the layers, so remove a geofence before reloading if you don't want it lingering in your account.

`main` is one commit ahead of `origin/main` — not pushed or deployed until you ask.

- `optimizeStops` now defaults to `false` (`DEFAULT_ROUTING_OPTIONS` in `src/types/routing.ts`), so the "Optimize stop order" switch in the Waypoints panel starts **off** and stops keep the order you give them until you turn it on. The hook already keys entirely on that flag, so no solve runs while it's off, and switching it on later solves immediately for the current stops.

import sys,json; raw=sys.stdin.read(); body,code=raw.rsplit(' HTTP ',1)

except Exception: print(code.strip(), body[:80])"; done

### CLAUDE (2026-08-24T23:53:00.276Z)

Done — Simplified Chinese is in, committed as `7b7d473`, working tree clean, test tab closed.

**zh-CN support**
- New locale **简体中文** in Settings → Language, with a full UI catalog (all ~150 strings), Chinese date/time picker (dayjs `zh-cn`, MUI `zhCN` texts), and locale number formatting.
- **Navigation checked**: the API returns Simplified Chinese instructions only for `lang=zh` (or `zh-Hans`); `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `zh-Hant` all fall back to English. So the locale maps Navigation → `zh`, while Discover (which rejects bare `zh`) and reverse geocoding use `zh-CN`. Verified live in the app: UI in Chinese ("19 英里 · 44 分钟 · 15 个步骤", "通行费 $14.92–$24.06") and turn-by-turn steps like "出发向西北，驶入 East 165th Street，随后左转，驶入 River Avenue", with `lang=zh` on the navigation request.
- Not added: Traditional Chinese — the Navigation API has no working Traditional variant today (`zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` return English), so I left it out rather than ship a locale whose directions can't follow the UI.

**Housekeeping**: I switched your saved language back to English (US) after testing. I also noticed your persisted POI filter is currently an empty selection with "All categories" off — that hides every POI on the map; flip "All categories" back on in Settings if that's unintended.

`main` is two commits ahead of `origin/main` (optimize-stops default off, zh-CN) — not pushed or deployed until you ask.

### CLAUDE (2026-08-25T15:11:37.283Z)

Done — committed as `4df2096`, working tree clean, test tab closed.

**What was wrong**: the route polyline was inserted before the style's first text-label layer. In the Orbis traffic styles the incident layers (and flow layers) come *before* that label layer, so the route ended up painted over them.

**Fix**: a new `routeAnchorLayerId()` (in `src/utils/mapStyle.ts`) picks whichever comes first in the style — a traffic overlay layer (`TrafficIncidents - …` / `Traffic - …`) or the first label — and the route is inserted before it. Checked against both style variants: no traffic → still anchored at `Borders - Treaty label` (unchanged behaviour); incidents on → anchored at `TrafficIncidents - No delay outline`, so every incident (and flow) layer, plus labels and shields, now draws above the route.

**Verified in a fresh tab**: with incidents on and a Jersey City → Woodside route, the red incident segments render over the blue polyline where they overlap. Content layers keep their label-anchored position (unchanged); route vertex handles stay on top as before.

`main` is one commit ahead of `origin/main` — not pushed or deployed until you ask.

KEY=$(grep '^NEXTBILLION_API_KEY=' .env.local | cut -d= -f2 | awk '{print $1}'); SCR=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-[USER]-workspace-tomtom-playground/be5a46ff-85a2-48fc-9a66-ace04b4ac027/scratchpad; curl -s "https://api.nextbillion.io/orbis/style/0.4.4-0/style.json?apiVersion=1&map=basic_street-light&trafficIncidents=incidents_light&trafficFlow=flow_relative-light&key=$KEY" -o $SCR/both_style.json; python3 - $SCR/both_style.json $SCR/inc_style.json <<'EOF'
import json,sys
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    L=json.load(open(f))['layers']
    idx=lambda pred: [i for i,l in enumerate(L) if pred(l)]
    flow=idx(lambda l: l['id'].startswith('Traffic - ')); inc=idx(lambda l: l['id'].startswith('TrafficIncidents'))
    roads=idx(lambda l: l.get('source-layer')=='roads' and l['type']=='line'); label=idx(lambda l: l['type']=='symbol' and 'text-field' in (l.get('layout') or {}))
    water=idx(lambda l: l['id'].startswith('Water'))
    print(f.split('/')[-1], '| layers', len(L), '| flow', (min(flow),max(flow)) if flow else None, '| incidents', (min(inc),max(inc)) if inc else None, '| road lines', (min(roads),max(roads)), '| water', (min(water),max(water)), '| first label', label[0])
    print('   first flow/incident layer id:', L[min(flow+inc)]['id'], '| layer before it:', L[min(flow+inc)-1]['id'])
EOF
